Friend, Last week, we shared how 24 Democratic attorneys general have already been forced to go to court to fight back against new federal actions on voting. This didn’t come out of nowhere. Even as the SAVE America Act stalls in Congress, pieces of it are already being put into place at the state level. Over the past two years, **more than 20 states have started changing their voting rules.** New proof-of-citizenship requirements. Stricter ID laws. Systems that scan voter rolls looking for supposed non-citizens. Actual cases of non-citizen voting are extremely rare. At the same time, these systems have mistakenly flagged and even removed eligible voters. That’s how this happens: A problem that barely exists gets used to justify changes that make voting harder for real people. And now those same ideas are being pushed at the federal level. **That’s why attorneys general are stepping in.** They’re trying to stop this before it spreads further and becomes harder to reverse. body:
Trump orders the Navy to shoot any boat laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz — and Iran isn't backing down.

|
---
|
---
Sponsored By:
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckbuO2zAQRb-G6mTwPWKhIonhbrMpAqQURhzSJpZ6gKI2vx_YFhLX6XjmXBIXnF9vwxumnObrd5xCX2ocaKGhpHnZKBRMud7Chp8BfZ2X2Q-SS9ty3Uo1zHmQDfXkCYVvQi8ArOuc4aa59V30HYGGOCKnOMpoQRnTcR6FsaTGJvX3p7iWmnMhtDlp6owXTo4RRgvKMc0xh1JPJaz7mJPHueL2EZfiw8kvU5P7W63rxtQXJi9MXnLIweePu2PyAqDIgYJWeoJWg3Uthshb4XjnnLBc2cjUxeO0YrrOQyKmzgy-vg7gzKRdseD0dO9GtO_S8EPs4_PWzx_fmLR7nYZt2YsPz_ALP-J3rqFM_-yD_ropUNpf7MEPj0c5PDplnCmU5-w4w7kpPa2_U85ps8A0v06Y8uOn6n8s9rOXfwIAAP__RCGqAw)
The Permanent Campaign is brought to you today in partnership with
Republican Task Force Issue: 4/23/2026
Shoot to Kill in Hormuz

President Trump [ordered the U.S. Navy](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL1urDAQhZ_GdEZmMH-Fi9vQ7W1TosE2yyjGRvbsouTpI_II6U5xdM6n7-OxPJACxed_PLzJvC0uuSVTTMX5jBR49wXfHi3HFO0CCnqptIR2iWGByhlnHTa28qYZhn4ap0511W5whGmExrZat3Z0thvQus73jbWr6waoyNxTSoNWqml0V2s3draZYN2GtR_aSWiFwWeusz9fayCLkbF8bilbX9t0VMHszGcR7T8Bs4D5uq56zZ54xcx3Q8B8pkBMtgiY7zsBs9J3bgXMnF_HKVN2PhcZ8f0lOcmyp8SyHBiCXBNykS6n86T4lAdFXyRFWTgjsUyb3FM-Xt8C5iobd14UApV-EFo9D6TwS8l_kPo28BMAAP__bySHxQ) to “shoot and kill any boat” laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Trump posted on Truth Social that U.S. minesweepers would continue clearing the strait [“at a tripled up level”](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D1uxCAUBODT4I4VPIMNBUUad5s2pYUBr5_CjwXsrpTTR84RUs_oG2m-7uvdYsT8-LQpmNr31Re_Vsyl-VAtxn6EZl_Bup5LdiswmCgTFMY1xxUGb7zzlrshGD7Pk1ZaMjkcZgpsVG7fR6XZzqUHLRWHaRuBaRc0H9BcFBMgGONcyJvwSjquYdvnbZpHTQSzMdR-q-F8bhGdzd22771UF26upCGao_ezkfGDwEJg6Uc4MMYrI7AcJYUc3o3AYn3CjK1X27FkAotUQiglqS_ZRk97faaTYrWZXiXstOz0KDU9f2jCHC5jqMafb4wR2zQTwR7J4t_U0P_x2svAbwAAAP__ZDl8rA) as Iran’s commandos seized cargo ships in the waterway. Peace talks have collapsed, with Iran demanding the U.S. lift its naval blockade before reopening the shipping corridor. The Strait of Hormuz carries roughly 20% of global oil shipments. Iran has refused to negotiate while the blockade [remains in place](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L2OhCAUxfGnwQ6DiF8FxTZ2s-2W5grX4WYQDOC42affuI-w_T-_nJyvx_IA8hSen7CjTmVbbLRLohCzxQTki8MMbwRTQgxmkUL2XCgu2yX4RVZWW2OhMRXqZhj6aZw60VVOr71Ro-22VsA42E2MvRGtacU0TZ0SK1Skb0ooqYRoGtXVyo6daSa5bsPaD-3ElACPqdQJj3P1ZCAUyK8tJoO1iXvltSvlyKz9YHJmcr6uq74gOwrPEgN-w04B050yOQe88t04KshdPDMyOatOiaaXTM4lnfvBs4ux8Bd5z9cIhd8AdzHt5w-nBIF7BIuJyblK2h4XeU-5H5gSzx3I_60q_zjxreVvAAAA__9igYJP), leaving both sides with no diplomatic off-ramp in sight. ★★★
Hegseth Ousts Navy Secretary

War Secretary Pete Hegseth [fired Navy Secretary John Phelan](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL1uwyAURp_G3rAwxj8MDF28pWtH6xou8VUxICBx8_ZV-ggdP33S0dH5um03IE_h_gkn6lzdZqPdMoVYLGYgXw8s8EQwNcRgNsHFxLhkYtiC30RrtTUWetOi7ud5Uosa-dge2kjHndqdWoaRg7V8nNXw3v3IjVtES_qN4lJIzvtejp20y2h6JXY379M8qEZy8JhrlzE9dk8GQoXy7WI22Jl4tl4ftabSDB-NWBuxXtfVufgT8CrvvxFrip4qmdKItebHmVjKQAULi49S0bIAzxcraDJWyC-WDvQQGJxkWcVQKIbCEoYK9xiYR7CYy0Gpzdqmi7ynMs2N5PcTyP8p1X8UfGrxGwAA__-BEoSK) “effective immediately,” ending Phelan’s 13-month tenure. The rift centered on Phelan’s approach to shipbuilding reform and his relationship with uniformed Navy leadership, which had frustrated Hegseth for months. Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell [announced the departure](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LFuwyAQxvGngc0RxocxA0MXb-na0Tof5xiVYAtIqrx9lT5C5-_Tb_h_XZcrxhTz7RPv7EvblnCEpcR81MAFY2o7V3wyUstHpkUrPXYKOj0sOS1aBh8oYE-SfW_t6CZnlJG7DxOxcrj2E9IawMIEZhutARhoAKNk9G9KgQal-h7MBcJkqHd63ew62sEJUJi4tEvh87GmSJgb1u_tKMQXOu4y-b21s4rhQ-hZ6LntvMeU3pvQ83mkSC-h58Ab58pCz2aCwTnVZXy-uspUuGF5defOCXMX-MTSHuX9lMWH8yemFOtoBajbHeMfLNs_Gj29_g0AAP__0xR16w) via X without offering a reason. Navy undersecretary Hung Cao, a 30-year Special Operations veteran, stepped in as acting secretary. The firing comes as U.S. warships conduct an [active blockade of Iran](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDHO3CAQRk-DO1bAYrALijTu_rQprTGMDQkeLCDr7O2jzRFSf5-ent6Pr_ULUk50fIcTXe37GkpYa6LSAlZIuUds8ELwnQr5VQlluNBcPVfKqxqCCz6A9AM6aa2Zp3kU4xCdQe233U5PswlpNEzaoggG5bTZXYhxSO6DElppIaTU40OHafRyVttuN2OfM9MCMtb-qHj93nLyQB3ar71Ujw9fziG72PvV2PMbUwtTy33fjxtaTHT0QvgHzkRYP1emlqvk5N9MLQF3pIZMLXrUQkn1GbEjj3g07JF3pJYKcYLXm_8skfgVMQPxC6nDUYipZaguXHfKOTVjmRbHCSn_k-r_0fDl1N8AAAD__-RGghQ) and mine-clearing operations in the Strait of Hormuz. ★★★
FBI Probes Reporter Covering Patel

The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) investigated a New York Times reporter after she revealed that FBI Director Kash Patel [used bureau personnel](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLuO5CAQAL8GZ4x4-RUQXOJsL73QakPb7lsMFvTMaP_-tPcJG5dUJdWfj_UDKFE-fsOFvvK-xhLXSrm0iBUo8YkNXgiBc8lhNcoMUjlp7JrTarroY4igQ4dej-MwT3Ov-u704wSTxaDmAINGYx30vQtWz3oDZe3Wkf9WKWecUlq7_uHi1Ac9m20ft2G0s3AKElZ-VLyfW6IAmaF97qUGfIRydcmfzHcT9pcwizALn3hSSt9MmOUsF2Z8N2GWCyOBMEs_OTepUe4bScovbEwHMDaZ8S2_Sv2UTBc2-bc8a4ZEjeUNjEkeVNNeCXOUDcOzEn8Js3TVx_tNKVEbRuHUcQH9r3f8g5Evb_4FAAD__1jyhFQ) to provide security and transportation to his girlfriend, country singer Alexis Wilkins. The Times identified the reporter as Elizabeth Williamson, calling the probe “alarming”—[the first known investigation](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD2y3CAQhE-DMrYQYvUTEDhR9pw6VI1gWI0XgQpGWr_bu-QjOOugq7-u79fX8gUUKb1-wo62cFh89kuhlKvHAhR5wwoXguOUk1u00r1URupuSXHRjbfeeWhdg7Ydhn4ap6d6NpvtJ4OrA62MGodhHI0ajWl7CK6fOgihIXtPKaONUm1rng_jx6drJ72GYe2HbhJGQcTCj4LHuUZykBjqO-Ti8OHy3kS7MR9VdD-EnoWeC3jKj5D_JPzUuyH0fDOEnpW5cyf0_Ia6yQMYY5VhJUnpwsr0AkYvE37kdy5vybRjlb_zWRJEqixDLrLgkQtTeskzBbhygTWirJzLt4Q1nyw3uplNsf74UIxU-0EY9dqB4r_H_B-CL6v_BgAA__-QFoxm) of a journalist for covering the bureau’s own director. The FBI denied Williamson was “personally investigated,” claiming the inquiry stemmed from a death-threat case against Wilkins. Some Justice Department officials [saw it as retaliation](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L9uwyAQgPGnwRsRPoP_DAxdvKVrR-sMR3wKAQtoqr59lTxC50_6Dd_XdbsiR063T3yQLS1sPvutcMrVU0GO7aCKT0LXUk5uAwWjVFrCsKW4Qeetdx5715Htp2lc5sUo0x120qRJm7kP-x4mxMEh-H7YlaKFYDQd2xelNGil-l6bi_azcf0Ce5j2cRoWoRVGKu1S6PzeIztMDes95OLo4vKji_Zo7axi-BCwCljbQQfH-GoC1nxy4pwErJGTr_RbZaRUBaxm1sYMWt6xHvLERlGGneVZqFYZCpF_A12x_vzhGLmOk9Dq9kB-4137x6enhb8AAAD__yPed5s) with no legal basis; the investigation was ultimately closed.
* * *
Virginia Judge Kills Redistricting Win

Virginia Circuit Court Judge Jack Hurley ruled the April 21 redistricting referendum unconstitutional from the start, declaring [all votes “ineffective.”](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LGunDAQheGngc4rY2xYChdp6G7alGgYD-woXhvZA-Txo02T_tZHOvr0__pavoAjp_0nvMkX2ZaQw1I45RqoAEd5UYWLACXlhIvRZlDaKtMvKS6mDT5ggA5b8t04DtNzctq1Lx8IOnTG4Do6h9OwWodmNYN7hq0HvbXsP1faGqt111n3sOHpsJvMuo3rMPZTYzVEKvIodJxrZIQkUH9vuSA9ML_b6F8iR236H42ZGzPf9_3Y8p9Ed_3sjZmPHFkYa2Pmi8vOiUFhPouoQBihUFVVQKiqQoGrFEbhtKsrC6kzYU5VWE7hnCCqSDtEdXNS_0W1LT4cN8fIdRgbq_c3cPzHk2_UvLz5GwAA__9514nh) Virginia AG Jason Miyares promised an immediate appeal, preserving existing GOP-friendly congressional maps heading into November 2026.

clean_body: Trump orders the Navy to shoot any boat laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz — and Iran isn't backing down. | | Sponsored By: The Permanent Campaign is brought to you today in partnership with Republican Task Force Issue: 4/23/2026 Shoot to Kill in Hormuz President Trump to “shoot and kill any boat” laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Trump posted on Truth Social that U.S. minesweepers would continue clearing the strait as Iran’s commandos seized cargo ships in the waterway. Peace talks have collapsed, with Iran demanding the U.S. lift its naval blockade before reopening the shipping corridor. The Strait of Hormuz carries roughly 20% of global oil shipments. Iran has refused to negotiate while the blockade , leaving both sides with no diplomatic off-ramp in sight. ★★★ Hegseth Ousts Navy Secretary War Secretary Pete Hegseth “effective immediately,” ending Phelan’s 13-month tenure. The rift centered on Phelan’s approach to shipbuilding reform and his relationship with uniformed Navy leadership, which had frustrated Hegseth for months. Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell via X without offering a reason. Navy undersecretary Hung Cao, a 30-year Special Operations veteran, stepped in as acting secretary. The firing comes as U.S. warships conduct an and mine-clearing operations in the Strait of Hormuz. ★★★ FBI Probes Reporter Covering Patel The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) investigated a New York Times reporter after she revealed that FBI Director Kash Patel to provide security and transportation to his girlfriend, country singer Alexis Wilkins. As the United States races towards its first military defeat in an international war, it behooves observers to consider how the entire effort--from the motivations for the war on Iran, its results, supposed diplomatic breakthroughs, and military losses--have all been the subject of institutional lies from Washington.
Given the president's history, no one should be surprised. I've written before about how the [first casualty of war is the truth](https://substack.com/redirect/b9e0a7e4-c457-4ec8-bd72-b8e14bb88d55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It becomes especially important to remember that when examining how his [subservience](https://substack.com/redirect/49c6096a-3283-4b59-9f53-e9e9f23eed83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to international [terrorist](https://substack.com/redirect/976c14a5-f063-4e40-973a-83ce9f9f897d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Benjamin Netanyahu might ultimately [destroy](https://substack.com/redirect/c29f45b7-c562-4ffc-8710-da061fd272cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the global capitalist economy, and this country's role as a global superpower.
_Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! Help inform your friends by sharing this post._
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=195301433&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk1MzAxNDMzLCJpYXQiOjE3NzY5OTI2NTMsImV4cCI6MTc3OTU4NDY1MywiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.mghcaTqXCDgorFtJPNUF5Mg8ehLGwuv_RIC4H24qs2I)
### **Lies, lies, and more lies**
Over the years since he [first](https://substack.com/redirect/2edae97b-2059-4d23-a8b9-268c9a90c31c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) came to Washington, the president has lied about seemingly everything. One analysis found that, over the course of his first term alone, he lied in public [over 30,000 times](https://substack.com/redirect/d5ff65c0-eed7-46a3-8b48-ef8fde213d63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
He has repeatedly lied about [voter fraud](https://substack.com/redirect/9d18c194-3b93-4ed4-a9d4-5b5bf00b9bd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--most recently [today](https://substack.com/redirect/d55ffe6d-df5d-4e76-a19e-bc4f9574cfb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), in response to a redistricting vote in Virginia yesterday that favored Democrats, and any number of times about the results of the [2020 election](https://substack.com/redirect/638c850e-b870-4261-b999-8ab74807711d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
He has repeatedly lied about the impact of his [economic policies](https://substack.com/redirect/d18b4616-75e7-42b7-9b3a-13138bd4c572?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as well as the country's economic [performance](https://substack.com/redirect/3d55fa60-6920-4952-b4ab-ef702d51b49e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) under his [supposed](https://substack.com/redirect/a41e209c-0048-4dec-80d9-1359791ff4f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) leadership. He has lied repeatedly about [energy costs](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea73242-fac3-49ee-9fb3-ca7f85768a03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as well as gas prices, grocery prices, and the overall inflation to which they continue to contribute.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b0e84858-a530-4191-b077-f6b3ad3b17e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
He has repeatedly lied about his own [physical health](https://substack.com/redirect/d3241f09-64e1-430c-9c93-aa30d610be46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Even his own former supporters have come to doubt his [mental health](https://substack.com/redirect/21949e0b-d933-45c8-8690-d887c87f0cce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which has also been the subject of his continuing lies.
He has repeatedly lied about [his own fortune](https://substack.com/redirect/f5e429fe-9d56-49c3-b8f0-9bd26a4c0e8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [where](https://substack.com/redirect/85d692de-b8c3-4941-8608-ac13667dcff9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it came from.
He has repeatedly lied in [court](https://substack.com/redirect/5b75cfd6-afe1-42b9-96b9-caa3f3111cf9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), at [campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/b89f6476-1c9a-49a1-aa26-d2a41ca98ca3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) events, in speeches before [international](https://substack.com/redirect/2e5a7777-2af7-498d-8b4a-a7e681f1528d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) bodies, during his [State of the Union](https://substack.com/redirect/6001af67-8f52-4186-ada7-fedcfc2048e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) addresses, and more or less every time he opens his mouth.
He has repeatedly lied about [immigrants](https://substack.com/redirect/b89f6476-1c9a-49a1-aa26-d2a41ca98ca3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), about supposed [crimes](https://substack.com/redirect/2fdb276e-d449-4d54-a968-bdff84d9de4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) committed by immigrants, and about our [impact](https://substack.com/redirect/8e1fde4d-f697-40c4-b1a3-55bf861c1c14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the American economy.
Why would anyone be surprised that he has yet to utter a single accurate statement about the war [he launched](https://substack.com/redirect/49c6096a-3283-4b59-9f53-e9e9f23eed83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Iran?

### **Lies about the war on Iran**
Trump lied about [how and why](https://substack.com/redirect/46551b3b-7dc3-41b9-9e5c-4190160b7110?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the war began, falsely claiming in public that an Iranian attack was imminent before [admitting](https://substack.com/redirect/46551b3b-7dc3-41b9-9e5c-4190160b7110?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Congress that was untrue. It is the exact [same](https://substack.com/redirect/f5bc5326-fb92-4b6c-8f05-72d1da5061ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) lie relied upon by George W. Bush and Dick Cheney when they launched an internationally illegal attack on Iraq 23 years ago.
Like his predecessors, Trump then lied about the [prospect](https://substack.com/redirect/b872d56f-0b10-4962-99d9-d591f12b0d5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of victory, falsely claiming the war on Iran would be over "pretty quickly" after the bombing campaign he approved.
Since then, Trump has continued to lie about how the war is proceeding. He lies about mounting [troop casualties](https://substack.com/redirect/8b3d9a8a-9cde-43c8-be45-d275ae9211ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He has lied about U.S. [warplanes](https://substack.com/redirect/7b0c0c9e-1400-436e-9361-ed54962dd7b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) being shot down in Iran. He lied about [missile interceptor](https://substack.com/redirect/0fdd6670-ed14-44f8-83f3-1ff7cf9dafe9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) capacity.
Trump lied about ceasefires, claiming that one had taken effect even while violating his administration's promises by [maintaining](https://substack.com/redirect/1cd845fc-7d1c-4c55-8a1e-75fd19590c5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a blockade on Iran. Last week, that blockade led to the [closure](https://substack.com/redirect/12834c6a-dfd8-4dcb-95af-c32910366022?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the Strait of Hormuz [after](https://substack.com/redirect/e5878937-c3f7-4357-bd89-db6b89d6c476?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Iran had already agreed to open it.
The president has also lied about [negotiations](https://substack.com/redirect/f7448492-9b9a-4c35-98e4-86143bc0c054?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He claimed last weekend that Vice President J.D. Vance would [not](https://substack.com/redirect/a6179256-06d7-4aa4-b3de-c8c5f109abe8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) be involved in further talks. Yet, this Tuesday, Vance [set off](https://substack.com/redirect/ffeb6cf5-2340-4a9e-8cb5-b6383ca61519?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for a further round of negotiations, only to return to the White House before even leaving the country when Iran refused to participate.
There's no reason to be surprised by that, either. In line with his thoroughly consistent pattern, Trump has bombed Iran _in the midst of negotiations_ --not once, but [twice](https://substack.com/redirect/d22b825e-6553-469d-85d2-eaa7dea14593?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

### **Who 's telling the truth?**
It's worth observing which figures have admitted the truth, even inadvertently.
Secretary of State Maro Rubio is the highest ranking official to observe the president's [subservience](https://substack.com/redirect/a8d4b7fc-fa8e-4550-873b-8350c3789921?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to international [terrorist](https://substack.com/redirect/976c14a5-f063-4e40-973a-83ce9f9f897d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Netanyahu. He has also gone further, [observing](https://substack.com/@kenklippenstein/note/c-236123177) the moral depravity of of governments "spending billions of dollars...building up all these weapons," rather than "invest[ing] that money for the people...."
Of course, Rubio was referring to Iran, rather than the U.S. But his insight applies no less forcefully here. In fact, given the absurd level and [consistency](https://substack.com/redirect/9145d0f6-5483-41db-875d-71933d976210?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of U.S. military spending under administrations from each of the fascist political parties, his critique is far more apt to America than to Iran.
Last week, the Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, [explained](https://substack.com/redirect/52bee5cd-264c-43e4-ad90-f9f0aaf7a8c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "The President of the United States made seven claims in one hour, all seven of which were false. They did not win the war with these lies, and they will certainly not get anywhere in negotiations either."
Iranian officials told the truth when claiming to have [shot down](https://substack.com/redirect/ac974588-2d22-4424-97fd-2d79db955d24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a U.S. F-15 fighter at the beginning of this month. It was the first time in 20 years that the Pentagon had lost an aircraft to hostile enemy fire. Iranian officials apparently told the truth again when claiming to have [destroyed](https://substack.com/redirect/1585276f-4be4-4898-bfc9-84b588838277?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) four more aircraft--two C-130 military transport planes and two Black Hawk helicopters--during the Pentagon's ultimately successful effort to rescue a downed U.S. weapons systems officer.
Iran appears to have exposed the president's lies several other times: when making verified claims about disabling multiple (and [capturing two](https://substack.com/redirect/01c31d0c-db38-45a3-92d3-2562082d3269?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz this week, when describing the [history](https://substack.com/redirect/2ffd6552-883f-4bf8-b389-219a45f2feaa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of a CIA coup that toppled a democratic government in Iran 75 years ago, when observing Trump's ongoing [obsequious](https://substack.com/redirect/d40d70bb-c03b-49b3-8e6c-62485d1fa648?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) deference to international [terrorist](https://substack.com/redirect/976c14a5-f063-4e40-973a-83ce9f9f897d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Benjamin Netanyahu, and even when speaking out about the interests of the American people diverging from those of our corrupt, self-interested, and lying leaders going forward.

As the highest officials in the U.S. government continue to shamelessly lie in public, there has never been a more important time to refuse to work.
We have nothing to lose [but our chains](https://substack.com/redirect/088fb35e-641f-46c4-bcb8-1c9cef536311?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

My friends, five years ago today, I was sworn in as Attorney General of California.
On this anniversary, I’m reflecting on what we’ve done so far, and the work that lies ahead.
Over the last five years, we’ve built a wall of protection around this state. A legal fortress around our freedoms and our values that no one — not even the most unlawful president — can tear down.
From Day One, my vision for the California Department of Justice has been that we keep Californians safe and serve as the nation’s largest and most powerful check on the abuse of power. And we’ve done it:
We’ve put public safety first, and successfully combatted fentanyl traffickers, gun traffickers, and human traffickers. We’ve held greedy corporations accountable, from Big Pharma’s fraudulent billing practices to Big Oil’s assault on our environment to Big Landlords colluding to drive up prices. We’ve secured justice for the innocent targets of fraudsters and schemesters.
Through it all, we’re defending our foundational rights and freedoms from the ongoing assault of a federal government and President who are hell-bent on tearing them down.
And importantly, we are securing the California Dream for the next generation.
That’s what this is all about.
I’m the child of two social justice warriors who were fighting for democracy and human rights. They raised me to believe that people power is the most potent power.
From the civil rights movement to the farmworkers’ movement, and in the fight for democracy in countries around the world, we, the people, are responsible for transforming our future.
This is work worth doing, every way you look at it.
Five years into this job, I am fiercely committed to doing whatever it takes to protect Californians — which is why I’m incredibly proud to be on the ballot for re-election this year.
Together, we will stop unlawful power grabs from the federal government, defend our immigrant communities, protect reproductive freedom, and stand up to abuse of power wherever it appears.
Because we have proven that when California fights, we win.
But no single person can do these things alone — I will need you with me to continue this work.
Will you support my re-election campaign today with a contribution of $25, or whatever amount is meaningful to you? The link to give is right here: secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
We are at our strongest against the rising tides of tyranny when we stand together, each of us clear-eyed and committed to the roles we must play.
I’m ready. And I’m profoundly grateful to have you with me in this movement for freedom and justice for all.
Thank you for everything.
—Rob

| | Just 10% of Americans approve of Congress according to the latest Gallup poll, and the reason is that it has given up on tackling the big issues that matter to us.
First among these is affordability. The biggest complaint I have heard talking to voters is from people who have jobs but can barely get by. Costs are so high that they are unable to improve their lives and save for the future. In California, a lot of the problems come from the taxes that create the highest gas prices in the nation and the regulations that prevent more housing construction, leading to higher rents and home prices.
The federal government has also become a huge obstacle, taking away over $4 trillion dollars a year of our money to feed a welfare state bureaucracy that is full of waste and fraud. If we divided up this money and handed it back to people, every adult could receive $16,000 per year and we could still save over $1 trillion per year. Such a solution would help affordability directly by putting money back in our pockets. It would also reform a system that has created a ballooning national debt that will sink our country if we do not address it.
You don’t need members of Congress with their heads in the sand, ignoring the issues that matter most. You need someone who offers real solutions to the biggest problems that you and our country are facing. ---
| | Dear friends,
Someone cut a hole through one of our signs. It wasn’t just defaced, It wasn’t just taken down. It was cut.
It felt unsettling to see that amount of anger directed at it. That sign was a symbol of the hope, care, and change that I'm bringing.
But this act of vandalism tells me that our campaign is being seen and felt. That our people-powered movement is threatening to the established power structure and we will get push back.

| | **So let me say to whoever did this: I forgive you. And I hear you.**
The truth is, families in our District haven’t been given much of a reason to trust politicians. I completely understand the frustration voters feel when candidates run, win, and then turn their backs on the communities who elected them.
But I'm not a typical politician. I oppose the corporate lobbyists who use their money to sway votes, I reject the corporate PAC and AIPAC money that powers so many campaigns, and I won't stay silent when my own Party is in the wrong.
This campaign is different: It’s about changing the system so that we prioritize **People, Peace, and Planet.** It’s about showing up, listening, and fighting for our communities that have been ignored.
**You have a choice this year to elect a representative who is committed to centering you and our communities.**
No act of vandalism will intimidate us. If anything, it strengthens our resolve.

subject: Portland this Saturday — Come Join Me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Danielle Bethell PAC 20220 [Preferences](https://daniellebethell
body:
What’s happening in Portland is showing up across Oregon. Let’s talk.
[](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-r/) Friends,I'll be in Portland this Saturday for two meet-and-greets, and **I 'd love to see you there.**[Bison Coffee House](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-y/)
3941 NE Cully Blvd, Portland
**Saturday, April 25 at 2:00 pm**[Dick's Primal Kitchen](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-j/)
4905 SE Woodstock Blvd, Portland
**Saturday, April 25 at 4:15 pm** Come by, ask questions, and hear directly from me about why I'm running and how I'd lead.Portland used to be a place people were drawn to from across the country and world. **Now, people look at it and see a city that has been let down by single-party rule.** You see it in the empty storefronts, in the street conditions, in the number of people living in crisis, and in the number of businesses and families who no longer trust that the people in charge are willing, or able, to turn it around. [Donate Today](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-t/) That didn't happen all at once. **It came from years of bad decisions, weak follow-through, and a political culture that talks around problems instead of fixing them.** Portland may be the clearest example of it, **but it is not just a Portland problem**. It is a picture of what has happened across Oregon when government loses focus on safety, affordability, accountability, and basic competence.I'm running because I've spent the last several years working in the middle of these same challenges, not commenting on them from the outside. As a Marion County Commissioner, I've worked on homelessness, addiction, mental health, public safety, and economic pressure at the level where results matter. I've helped expand treatment and recovery capacity, supported crisis services, strengthened partnerships with law enforcement and service providers, and managed budgets with an eye toward what works and what doesn't.I'm not interested in making excuses for decline. **I 'm interested in fixing what is broken and restoring confidence that government can still do its job.**If you're in the Portland area, come by and join me on Saturday.I hope to see you there.Danielle Bethell
Republican for Governor**P.S.** If you can't make it on Saturday but want to help us keep building momentum, you can support the campaign here: [https://secure.anedot.com/friendsofdanielle/give](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-i/) [Donate Today](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-d/) [](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-h/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-k/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-x/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-m/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-fb-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-c/) | [ Tweet ](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-tw-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-q/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-li-ahhdrkk-hhlrhljhit-a/) | [ Forward ](https://daniellebethell.forwardtomyfriend.com/y-hhlrhljhit-E19159AE-ahhdrkk-l-f)

## Wildfires Destroy Homes Across Southeast
Rapidly growing wildfires have [destroyed at least 87 homes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGO2yAQhp8G34jIAEty4LDV1lUPaS-rVtuLRWCwJ8Imskmo376ir7DH0Xz69f_f78twcZRoGX-4GW2JeViwbglLwXXY8qNM6LZSKYVIK24w17ymMICAFy4UBzUER2kfVBdsRASUHdqjMUaABq26ySqQaFzwV1AmnIOPJxBaCRHPUolwEh3ZliYUqKMQRh4PQpzP8tqY6_EUtGJKYKCS18Mt01ImjGnPT1wPPs9dslMp943JVwY9g77WenC-UF7akJv72ygGfbsY9Cl7lxrmip94oify6-qWknDnPj-WsvMcI3lyaeNjez_uwRXkE41TdTs_AW8mGPTwR3_7ePtlpO61fnt___Lx-vPrRSr5nUHfrTbcK6VE24thSoyzo_S_cPmU5aeFfwEAAP___b6Qhw) in Georgia's Brantley County alone as drought and wind-fueled flames scorched the Southeast, with new evacuation orders issued Thursday afternoon. Georgia's two biggest fires burned more than 53 square miles combined, and crews responded to [34 additional fires](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGK2zAURb9G3ilIz_LIWXhROlGGgXTRFlpmY2TryVGRpUF6E5G_L2mhP9DtvXC55_y4zBcbYkjbF7vjRD7PCVuNSIRlrvmDrmgrtRCdDwUr7C2X6GYQ8MSF4qBmZ0O8z6pzk0cE7DucpNZawACD6q6TdM6DHu0IGtQyrr2Xq176vndayuNouzA91oQCJYXQvTwIcTz2y6CEWOToBsWUQBcol8OvHBJd0cd7vmE5rHnv4nQleq-s_8TAMDCttUOrC90eLQPzwGFgYl5tZGA2zGULlv8j4pUsYeXRlg0r8b-hFFwOfM2JbEjo-G6Ts5TLnS8fJfHFJo7e40oMzMvP87fn1-Fyfnv-_nY-DcPnr6_m5aT1iYHpyuTeW4gx1CfNlNh2G-Kf4_Rftm8T_A4AAP__XqOTQA) across the state. Gov. Brian Kemp declared a state of emergency for more than half of Georgia's counties. Southeastern Georgia has received just 11 inches of rain since September, nearly 15 inches below normal, prompting the state's forestry commission to issue a [burn ban for the first time in its history](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOqKZwcakcLFNumy7JTL2GGZl4sg4Qfn7J17xfuCVV1e6uuf8u093J0key1-3sa0xTw8-9sS1cpn2_Koru70ekkKUwjttRy4pTAQ0dKA6UlNwkj6TaoONzMR9yxaNMUCatGpX69XcA_UcGZ1GHeM8Ihn0DnFQGMZW7LkGihQCmB4vANdrP2sFMOMYtGoUcJCay-V_lkddOaZPfnO5-Ly1ya61Pvem_9PQraGbe54AZ3WGUsUnbuj2Q9AtnMsirospFwmuCyW_lrV2w0jGk47zaOKgcWZwfPUYYB7AoxnaYsPzkJRkH0yjYNmcpO8L9Vfe3pa-AgAA__8BFIBQ). In Florida, firefighters battled more than 130 wildfires in what officials called one of the worst fire seasons in decades. Blazes also shut down rail lines, [stranding Amtrak passengers for more than 20 hours](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLESmzAQRL9GdGLEIcAUKtKoc9qUjEAnI-dAHnFG8d9ncJEfSHc3s7O7b3_dp7uLFPfHT7eh4ZCmHctByIx5OtKbV3QHl0g-xIwHbCVl8hMo6KXSEvTkXaTPpCtvAiJgW6FphmFQ0EGnq9V0fQ9zoxE8-iH423jTMC6dHxo1d6DaKprLTWnQjVJD29RKjWM7d1qpubn5Tgut0EdOuX6muPOKgT7pxFwvaavIrMyvQ7Q_BFgBtpRSXwj66f5cAgH2egVYSosjAfZKE2CV_t4C7OaeKct_jBJDwIXjifSRx_pm6VPZpds4u9-SszuRZNyl271Mb5YpyEApR-8E2Cob_yqRKB79ILR6bC7Styj_17qngb8BAAD__2objdg) near Palatka.
## Meta to Lay Off 8,000 as AI Costs Mount
Meta confirmed Thursday it will [cut about 8,000 workers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAUhZ9GOydwvYgWFNtMN9tuaRAuIxuUCVzH-PYb9xX-8uQk5-T7_rzml40p7u_fdiPDIc87nTURM5W55oNXspXPmHyIhSpsZy7JzyBg6AR2gLO3MV0ztt4EIqC-JSO11gIUKGxXI620buhHDX2Afpyc8tNIGqyTy2AJ22juNYGAUgjdy4cQ09QvCoVY5OgVNijIR87l8TfHnVcK6cpfKg-XtzaZlflTm_5XA88GnvZzA9zVHQpHl6iB5xZdyTUH7r45HTvbcnXLceWDa2djB4BEhDhObnEAGhCVGkMQENQkJ9sW4z9nTCnWQTco3puN6f8__0ja18C_AAAA__-Kqn87), or 10% of its workforce, beginning May 20 as the company redirects spending toward artificial intelligence. Another 6,000 open roles will go unfilled. The company warned investors its 2026 expenses will reach [$162 billion to $169 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOwyAQRL8Gd1jLGoekoLjGXa690gKzxEQ4RGYTlL8_-X7hupGeNKN5P9f56lJOj9u328hyLPODWs3ETPtcy4tXcpVbyiGmnSpurew5zAh4kqAl6jm4lD-z7oKNREhDR1YZYwBHHHW3WlJ-vAweR-dNDPHk3WIGZZQhR4jGd8kebaBRKwAzqB7gchn8qAG8OodRCw0UEpe9v5f04JVi_pQ37f1Sti7blflZxfAlcBI4tdb6xdfjxcEFTkcUOG3ETmb3KTFWeQYA6ZK8Fy-XFx-82214tpRzqicjNNw2l_LfBP_Ly9vibwAAAP__VU12bA), driven by data center construction and compensation for AI engineers it has been hiring at record pay levels. Also Thursday, Microsoft offered [voluntary buyouts to roughly 8,750 U.S. employees](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OgzAQBOCnMZ2jZW3-ChfX0OXaK5HBS3BkY2RvgvL2J-4VrhtppG-k-blPd-uD3x_fNpLhNU07nSUQM-WppBdvZAufPrjVZyoYz5SDmxCwlaAl6slZHz6TrpxZiZBURabuug6wwUZXm7GkOph7hS0NDlrb0jAM2jnoe4vUq8qbSwONugboVH0DGAY1NxpgrnvXaKGBnOeUb8_kd95oDZ_0pnxbUqyC2ZiPItSXwFHgyLRsS37ty3bVAscLFziCvrISOEZiK59plsuLi6xBHpQX2ln2ACApHiF9iIrAscrGHacPwZe2Exoe0frwt8r_uupt8DcAAP__WDx6CA), or 7% of its domestic workforce, as it faces similar pressure from massive AI investment. Analysts said the twin moves reflect a broader shift across the tech industry, with companies betting that AI tools can automate tasks that once required large teams.
## Where Lightning Kills the Most by State
A new analysis of [lightning deaths by state](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO2zAQRL-G6misV5TkK1ikUXdpUwqkubQ2txINcs-G_j5QfuG6AWbwMHh_PpfPwML743fYyGsuy07vJqRKdWnlW1cKTd8sKXOlhtu7VEkLAo4WnEW3pMByLK5LPhMh9R356zRNgAMOrlu9uwIADlO-QbxRpHBP_S1myPdxjDiNHfuTBg7P5dRfLwAfH30cHEC83tLgjANKrKVe_hbedaUsR3lRvdzL1olfVZ_N9L8Mzgbn_XiWpmdlcD7BBmdwZ-4NzsKZmh5CBuemQanZo3xXsltpaoW_SA6rxUayXyxCycbDCj9W3Xl_2EovCkLJ4NxVn55vFuE2TsbBYwss_x_pjzS-PP4LAAD__5IGhlU) over the past two decades found Florida far ahead of the pack with 97 confirmed fatalities since 2006, more than double any other state. Texas ranked second with 42 deaths, followed by Colorado with 27, Alabama with 23, and North Carolina with 23. Florida averages 1.2 million strikes per year, fueled by the [collision of Gulf and Atlantic sea breezes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykULuS4yAQ_BopQ4UQCDkguMSZL71QhcUg5haBC8am_PdbWn_ChjP9qO7-d1tvFiOm_a89wJDPa4JWIxBBWWt-UgBbqWF0HgtUcbRcolsFFzPjkgm5OovxvcreGQ8gYOrBjFprLpRQsg_Gi035UftFXxa-LfdFzaCkH4W2WtpJ9WhONy6FHDnX0zhwfrlMdyU5v4-LU7KTHBxSLsP_jIkC-PjOLyjDlo8-mkD0qN30pxPXTlxba4PdtmcDS-HD6cQV0gl9XuxseJ7hzXzMBZ1lxaavygLuASoxnwuLuAdKmHbmLdmIhFAZJkYB2POUT4qreeyLcY-GMWKddSf5fliMP8HoV2u-jPgOAAD__0OHifM). Nearly two-thirds of all deaths occurred during outdoor activities like fishing, boating, and camping, with July being the [deadliest month](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMFuqzAQAL8GbqDFNnE4-PD0JE5JLz30iBy8hq0WHNmboPx91Ur9gt5HM9J8XKerJ6Z9efMbOolp2vEojCKYp5IesqIvchCHSBmL2o6UOUwK1KkB0ygzBU_8mkwdXERUqGt0nbUWVK96U69Oe_BhRjQnO5ytNqDPg557HSEOFrWuyX3bwCjTAVjdtQDDoG-9Abh159CbygAGkpTbz0S7rBj5lZ6Y2zltNbtV5F7pf5UaKzUyLavstC_FR5TXnB77TNymvFRqvLz_by6_QDN68UxCWNpVNq6zC_eDmKmcbGVg2TzxT0L-9OXp1FcAAAD__299d6Y). Adjusted for population, Wyoming has the highest fatality rate at 5.13 deaths per million, followed by Alabama and Montana. Five states recorded zero lightning deaths: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, New Hampshire, and Washington. ## First Education Savings Accounts Awarded
Award notices have been sent to more than 42,600 students who qualify for the state's new education savings account program, Acting Comptroller Kelly Hancock [announced](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8GdxPhMYlNQZHG3dtmiy0tAkOMhCECHJ7f16-c_YStR3PuPffP1_KlffDx-UtvpOq3S0ukVgLVSnlxPpdKReumsy1r2ktNsRxRL8jxBlwAisVqH45FdFY9uJV9R6ofx5HjdJ1EtypphLBOIg23Abm8yqt0UkjtJseNudrOqxPGBYq-5wMfLud3bx_SGHz0OE1McLK-pnypK1X61sWFI70pX0zauqDWWl-FDXeGM8O5tXbZSjxvDGeKsBeG85YiHQznJ0XKOjCcPyD4ZwYfURCcw-ZD8CmCj_BOu1kpg9ujLVATmNUHmylC83WF8iLjdYBIZM8IneF-x_7nd_vpsrKvdpLKbWSCPzftw6dt_b-N3wr_BgAA__-un5Mm) Wednesday. The awards account for more than $400 million in funding. The group consists of students with disabilities and their siblings in households with an income at or below 500% of the federal poverty level. "_The Legislature made low- and middle-income students with disabilities the first priority for the first year of school choice here in Texas, and that is exactly where this process starts_ ," [Hancock said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSrCAQRb8GMyxocdSA4CVk89INLYR2pAplCtpx_PstZ6v2BzbroO_pvufrPt5tiGF7_LcranrPadzwKBGJMI9zyIWwWHvY7MuS9kJpK-dmRxBw40JxUKO3IZ6jqryehB9khVp2XSegb3tVLVqimxsx99i2vfeu8wM0AyA0ampvMEEV9AUTCpSUohFNfaWlnwbnYJLQ90wJ9IFSrmlBwrctczzTC3Pt0lpFvRA9C2v-MTAMzHEc9V4sJW_Pa4GBKZTyycBczRgY9LuzFNLGwFynGRihrrlhYD58XtySUuSvtLsFM3dLCg75b5DPGdGnlf-IYWD6oVODbAchOgamyto_jxBjKLeOKfFYbYifb-lvjl8avgMAAP__JOeP1w). More than 274,000 applications were received for the $1 billion program, but fewer than 100,000 students will be enrolled due to funding constraints. The comptroller's office will [conduct a lottery](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2yozAMhZ8GOmWMcQIpKLahu9tuyQhLBM0aO2OLS_L2O6TYF7i1fs75vj9f0xdKkPj4jRsP-lrSFPkogVU5T4vkolwQD8xU1rQXTbG8I07W2BsYB9ZNhBLek6tpmA3dm5qHpus6Y_tr7-p16E1n7lfvmfr5dl1adyfqFrf41jR49Ustw_nMOOuaxrSmvZzXDc137-3c2L6vnGESTfmiKyu_sCzhnb45X3za6jCsqs9Stb8qO1Z2PI7j8veF8RxWdjxpKjsy7R5VUqzsuKXMoCtGcPZmDBTdiaMWOERXQCApOEsQfYNEH3aS-ABdWTIUmU9ZBdB7fioTSNQEn1LwPwOWzExpO7fSHhWeOT0ynnXqPNDzkBCk3LrKmceGEj4c-jP734P9FwAA__-9Zp7Q) next week for students in the second tier--those from families with incomes at or below 200% of the federal poverty level. Students who aren't selected will be put on a waitlist. Today, a federal judge will [hear arguments](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkT2u2zAMgE9jbwwkWX12Bg1dsr2uHQ1aomMCimSITPJy-8JBbtCVPx_5kX-_52_kzOX6B28U9Getc6GnZFKlNq_cREkQn9iSbPUuWou8Cs7OuC8wHpyfE3J-zb5PYTHpbHsKdhxH46Zfk--3YBOO5_NilsHZwS8-psHGMaUp0eCcjT2HA2a889aawQyno9um5RyjW6ybps4bSqy1nXQjpR-UNb_qg9op1lufw6a6Szf87tylc5djfS9YsGgtXI-aT7Rzl1wj5s5d3hSQuNWa4VHvcaMGb0soVTmSgFBR0ArvG8C11fsOdYUVb5z5yGOBz4wPSGDHRkUF4sY5NSqwN36gEuC-Z46oXItAYsGFMyuT9C2k_ck5s3yNnTfXG3J-e-n_feMR3L8AAAD__wTUprg) in a lawsuit challenging Hancock's initial exclusion of several Islamic schools from participation in the program.
## JBSA Selected for Potential Nuclear Microreactor
The U.S. Air Force has selected Joint Base San Antonio (JBSA) as a potential site for deploying a [nuclear microreactor](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2upDAMhZ8mdBklJvwVKaahu9tuiQwxl6xCcpV4huHtV_AKtzuS5c8-39-v6Qt98PH7D-5k-bOmKdJRAjFTnlafC1NBPDC7sqVX4RTLGXECBa1URoKZHPpwTqZydlZu0BVZ3XWdgr7pTbXZVg0G9axnGJxph6ZrTKsHorqp-3U1XeXtBVMGjNaqVvXj2tZuHpYFZg19L4wi5znlB2_E9MGyhjO9KT-WtFfBbsw_RdRPAaOA8TiOx17iNRMwUpSvImC8SgkY7_wv-chyxkKyYJQYOUWfZMDoioyvJRBmmQkXTlmivCXI9c73dbn74BnzeTMEjJjl8wn6XWOqsnU_hw_Bl7YTRn3v6MP9J__O7tvC_wAAAP__d7aQMA) within the next few years. As part of the Advanced Nuclear Power for Installations initiative, the Air Force aims to install a modular nuclear reactor at one or more of its bases by 2030. Colorado's Buckley Space Force Base and Montana's Malmstrom Air Force Base have also been named as [potential sites](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3SAQhJ8GdxxhzPVPQZHG3U2b0lrDcr0RZo9gc37ePnKUN7j1fDOamV-f2ydQpvL1E0708kq8FXy2jCJYt0S1CTaAJ9TYDv7ThEt7F9issaM2Tlu3RaD83lwX_W7i0nfo-2majJ0_ZtcdHl1a0tCHcXE7LK7vjd2T2z_cGAabwtSRv8KMs5c2mOF2ufu4LyHYvbfzrJzBSML1JgcKvqCl_OYH1lvgs8v-ELk3NfxQdlV2TfxqUKAIF-KLUHa9Jim7Zg6QlV1_MxXROzTUDYr-z-oCJ0Z9Z8EiBFk3EtRUNFDViWtAfVKoXBGCcNVUSAiEHthVH-9PypnaOClnvk6g_K-cfO_Sh7d_AwAA__92cI9v) for a nuclear microreactor. California-based Antares Nuclear was [selected](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDtuwzAQBU8jdRQokjblgkUadU6bUlhKK4sBxTWW69_tAwe5Qfr3ZoD5Ok9nSDmVyyfsGOS50lTwUTOKIE9r4ipYAR7AS93oVoVKfRWYjDZHpZ0yblog5dfk2iVEvZz6FkPvvddmOAyu3UIffbQW4greOoj25O0A8egOBxi0XX2bwhumnXF9r6223fvdL_E0zyb2Zhgap3FJQtzJhoJPqGt-0R25m2lvc9hErrWxH40ZGzNWKFCESiLGK7F0xJfGjJBYrcQzqm9KRVSEiqpCUX9jVW5zRmC1p5lJMcIsxI0ZWw7L9ZFyTvXoG6cvO6T8a5b_9boH8xMAAP__uzaCKA) to lead the effort at JBSA, which includes the U.S. Army's Fort Sam Houston and Camp Bullis, as well as Lackland Air Force Base and Randolph Air Force Base. The company is developing a nuclear microreactor that can produce one megawatt of electricity--enough to power about 250 homes on a hot day. "_We're well overdue for a nuclear renaissance_ ," [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykUL2S2yAQfhrU4YEFW1JBkYbu0qbULLA6kSDhgb2T_fYZ5RXS7cx-_78-lg_MJR-fP3Enx6-1LgedvRAztWXNrTN1xBNb6lv96lyP_j5wAQUPqawEuyTM5b3YIbmg0qwHcnocRwXTfbLD5kJ6rPdgg5op0qTMqMfJ0CMGo425z-uQ3SWmLFitlVHmdrF1CnOMEDRMk7CKUubabrwR0wv7Wt71m9ot1n0obmN-dmF-CPAC_Hmetz8d-XoK8FcbAb7UiEWAv6wEeGWv2wjwmJtca4skOxWK3OXv0FFil8_KdHDGIntmukDy-IqFsMk9x1YbYeTaBPihufQ8cym5P0Zh1eeOufwLx_836beDvwEAAP__9V6Lbw) Bexar County Precinct 3 Commissioner Grant Moody. "_It's been 33 years since a nuclear power plant was put online here in Texas, and so I think that now's the time."_
## Former GOP Candidate Fined for Insider Trading
Ezekiel "Zeke" Enriquez, a former GOP candidate for the state's 21st Congressional District, has been fined for [betting on his race](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSgyAYhJ8GOxz8BSUFxTV2ufZKB-E3MCHgAYlJnv7GvMLVO_vt7Pdzns_aBx8v3_qGqj7XNEfcS8BaMc-rz6Vi0XrX2RaX7qWmWF5Rz8BgoIxT4LPVPrxm3li1MHvqGlTdOI4MpJC8cWoUJyPHVTIQFgY59LBwAQMfVgYchWi8OmCMA-861rO-PdqdXU7GwNKBlIQztL6m3FaHFZ-6rOGVHphbk25NUK7WrZD-i8BEYNr3vTUup3ikBKbjDoFJ5-pNQALTVYfiPP2AaMbtvgRvdKRvvCLFmP3vHd8UAIBJIdrNbU1Wdtt9CL4MI-HsctM-fMbr_5Q9FPwFAAD__zvzgGU) with Kalshi, a platform that allows users to wager on sports, politics, and other real-world events. Enriquez [finished 11th](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbFypDAMhp_GdN4xwouhoLjGXa69khFYBE289p6tDSFPf0Ne4SqpkP5vvvn_vM1vyJHT-2980CRfW54THTWSCJV541KFKuKBJdQ9v6rkVM-EMxjotbEa7ByQ4znbJkyLCWPb0NQ65wwM98E2-3S_9_dt2cJoXY8jrLajDW2gtafe0TA0PF1hxoJtW9OZ7nZ9t2EZ1xWWFoZBWUOBJZeb7CT0hXWLZ_6kclvzo4nTLvKsqvulwCvwx3HcXhUlBzyvAwW-Si6nAn-ZXQOFc1LgL64Cb-y1dwr8B8a6s944UdU_JF3o-Voir5j0iilwQCFN3_TBFDWlwn9f9K23XPQzRxZeMWpOlQMVLQUDp3cFfhiddUPXGeMU-KZM4XlwjFx7p6x5fyDHHxn5vwo-J_gXAAD__33DnE0) in the crowded primary to replace U.S. Rep. Chip Roy (R-Austin), which was won by former Texas Rangers first baseman Mark Teixeira. According to Kalshi's investigation, he bet less than $100 on himself to win the race. Kalshi fined Enriquez $784 and banned him from the platform for five years. "_Just like in traditional financial markets, bad actors will try to cheat,_ " [said Bobby DeNault](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uhDAQhU8DHcg2BkPhIg3dpk2JZvF4GcXYyJ79u31EcoS07-n96Pu6LBegQPH2CTtafvm0RHyWgMyYF0-5MBaAJ2RXtnQvnGJ5R1iUUEMjdKP04oDCe9G1s1fhJlmjlcYYocZ-1PVmwYjBmKn3o5xGj0M_CNF3q_ZCj1o6U5M9y4RWWkrRia4909Jdp3VVV6nGsdICHXHKLW_I-ILiwzs9MLdr2utgN-ajVN1HpeZKzef99htC2ej0KzUflZr_hOZIgZhWCA3FQg5zwxkcxVuD0ae84o6Rm_vhgLHO1h1PCoHKYCotbjtQ-J3k_4F6WPUTAAD__yQhfro), the company's head of enforcement. Enriquez has not commented on the penalty, but Kalshi's report stated he was "fully cooperative" with the investigation. Kalshi [also penalized](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u5CAQhE9jZ4wA47-AYBNnb9MNrQba49bDYNHM88ztV94rbFbSpypV1Z-v9QsoUnr-hgNtfW95TXhxxFqxrBsVrsgAF5TAe35xzYk_CVYt9SCkEdqsASh-VtMG62SYVYtWjeMo9dRPpt3tGPw0OrOFAWaY0YfeD4PunEK3hWnqW7J3mDTaKCU72T1utwpu9l47paepMRID1VwedceKb-AtfvIPlofPRxvtXuvJTfer0Uujl-u6Hsn5e8XNG724F1NC5kYvB5RvrLf6hsg7ie0mgl98YgoszhypkidILCgxBSyiFgiUngIj-ko5sSg-QWdUL_u22HBeFCPxMDZGPg-g-K9W_b8zf6z-GwAA___xRI1Z) Democratic candidates in Minnesota and Virginia for betting on their contests.

Virginia proves something hard but important:
Elections are won on the _ground_ and lost in the _margins_.
We did the math. **600 ballot-chasers** banking just 10 votes a day would’ve flipped the vote in Virginia.
Six hundred.

We’ve got to match them dollar-for-dollar. Chase The VoteTM is the only way patriotic Americans will ever win the elections we need to defend President Trump’s mandate.

🟢 Recruit and train our army of ballot-chasers 🟢 Door-to-door voter engagement 🟢 Ballot tracking and return operations 🟢 Early vote-banking in battleground districts

name: Jamie Davis
subject: The farming accident that changed my life
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jamie Davis for U
body:
August 8th, 2009, the worst day of my life, changed how I see everything: from family to the importance of our rural communities and it is a key part of why I am running for office.
| | | | | [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001wdBwu9nS4mZ88gHaDMrPB_owD8YCjcXrDKHtFckXJCWoQ3nn4sIPr4B4lB2D83Ulyt0rQ32NcOoipPGSBf0qVAywR-QgqChTZL-JdqtmmFjiL0b8MVPjn7njDs5k6n-mnpZBv5sXdQfJL2t3HPRZN1g68u4qugPxIBu6kwfvmpsOJfSrktiuCYMBc3yTVnF8xG11YUyjm1CHCY5IePVwhA==&c=6g2lTDFvWI39GoHVsYOJea8UeStyZOiULiPRFhP-AwmP0jre5BpLpQ==&ch=QhWh1ziz9UuVsD_ydxyFVEeo9BVAVnJaVDvSjvU2s39GRyQg7Lm-jA==)
---
Peter, August 8, 2009, is a date I will never forget.
Just days before his 19th birthday, my son Justin was out in the fields with us, doing what this family has done for over three generations--farming the Louisiana delta. A breakdown in our combine left corn spilled across the ground, and as we worked to recover it, Justin got too close. In an instant, his pant leg was caught, and the thresher pulled him in.
I can still hear his voice: "Dad, get me out."
And there was nothing I could do.
---
| [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001wdBwu9nS4mZ88gHaDMrPB_owD8YCjcXrDKHtFckXJCWoQ3nn4sIPr4B4lB2D83Ulyt0rQ32NcOoipPGSBf0qVAywR-QgqChTZL-JdqtmmFjiL0b8MVPjn7njDs5k6n-mnpZBv5sXdQfJL2t3HPRZN1g68u4qugPxIBu6kwfvmpsOJfSrktiuCYMBc3yTVnF8xG11YUyjm1DF7EadtWU_7w==&c=6g2lTDFvWI39GoHVsYOJea8UeStyZOiULiPRFhP-AwmP0jre5BpLpQ==&ch=QhWh1ziz9UuVsD_ydxyFVEeo9BVAVnJaVDvSjvU2s39GRyQg7Lm-jA==)
---
My son and I on the farm in 2021.
Multiple miracles occurred that day: When it initially happened he wasn't in pain because his nerves were pinched so tightly in the machine. Nor was he bleeding because he was caught so tight in there.
It took the jaws of life to tear apart that machine and when the metal finally gave way he let out a scream that I will never forget for the rest of my life.
The paramedics quickly sprang into action and he was airlifted to Jackson, Mississippi, where Doctors fought to save his leg, but the injury and infection from all the dirt and debris were too severe. Justin lost his leg from below the knee.
That day could have broken us. Instead, it showed me what makes Louisiana strong.
Neighbors, first responders from two parishes (what we call counties in Louisiana), and a doctor who wasn't even on duty, Dr. Ron Gregg, a farmer himself and longtime family friend -- showed up because that's what rural communities do. They take care of each other. They don't ask if it's their job or jurisdiction. They just show up.
Today, Justin is 35. He runs our farm. He's built a life, with a fiancee and a family of his own. He still hunts, fishes, and works the land -- just with a prosthetic leg and the same determination that carried him through that day.
But the truth is, the kind of community that saved Justin is disappearing. Rural hospitals are closing. Doctors like Dr. Gregg--who live in our communities, who know our families--are harder to find. Too many of our kids feel like they have to leave home to build a future.
And my family, who first worked this Louisiana delta soil as slaves and sharecroppers, and now as farmers who own this land, have put too much blood into this soil for us to leave and go somewhere else.
I have to take a stand and fight for our way of life and it's why I am proud to be the Democrat running for Senate in Louisiana.
If you believe in that fight, I'm asking you to stand with me today. A Democratic win here is the first step in taking our state back from the far-right whose policies of atomization and vicious corporatism are tearing our communities apart.
And mark my words, a win is possible, Democrats just won a deep red special election here by a landslide. [The blue wave will wash over Louisiana and we will flip this seat but only if we fight for it. Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-kqs1grv7ud-12933563?e=d1c1b9864f)

| |
# NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN
---
| | Friends and Neighbors,
Next week, the Legislature will return to Tallahassee for a Special Session called by Governor DeSantis. The session was called to address several important issues, including congressional redistricting, protections related to artificial intelligence, and medical freedom policies.
As always, please do not hesitate to [**contact my office**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=d02e60ce05&e=d1c1b9864f) if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can.
---
| |
# Property Tax Conference
---
[|
---](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=47c13f624f&e=d1c1b9864f)
| | On April 1st, I held a press conference to announce an effort to pass a citizen constitutional amendment that bans ad valorem taxes on real estate levied by any level of government. [**Click here to watch.**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=e159b08485&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
# Events in the District
---
|
---
| | **Attended the ribbon-cutting on CF’s newly renovated building** for their emergency medical services program. CF continues to expand and bring what our students need to further their education to get the career they desire.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| | **Attended the groundbreaking for the new Lake Weir Middle School.** Thanks to Congressman Fine, who has been working with our school board to bring funding to repurpose this building once the new school is ready. This project is an exciting new chapter for our students who plan on going to the new and improved Lake Weir Middle School. **Fun Fact:** 40 years ago, I was a 7th grader in this same building that the students are in now.
---
|
---
|
---
| | **It was a privilege to introduce CFO Blaise Ingoglia during his visit with Ocala Fire Rescue.**
During the ceremony, Ocala Fire Rescue was awarded $6,372.75 through state grant funding focused on cancer prevention and firefighter safety. These funds will support critical equipment and training aimed at reducing longterm health risks faced by those on the front lines.
Our firefighters answer the call without hesitation, this investment ensures we are doing our part to protect them in return.
---
|
---
|
---
| | Thank you for your continued support of my leadership in the Florida House! I look forward to sharing with you again soon.
Best regards,
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | **Ryan Chamberlin****State Representative****District 24**

During the ceremony, Ocala Fire Rescue was awarded $6,372.75 through state grant funding focused on cancer prevention and firefighter safety. These funds will support critical equipment and training aimed at reducing longterm health risks faced by those on the front lines. Our firefighters answer the call without hesitation, this investment ensures we are doing our part to protect them in return. | | | | Thank you for your continued support of my leadership in the Florida House! I look forward to sharing with you again soon. The Democrats win while we **all** continue to lose.
That's really the only way to describe what just happened in Virginia. A referendum passed that allows lawmakers to redraw congressional maps under the guise of "restoring fairness" until the next census. And if you read that at face value, it sounds reasonable. But, that's not what it is.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5887d171-b434-4775-baab-191aef6ecff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
What it actually does is take an existing map and reshape it in a way that gives Democrats a stronger advantage in the short term. And before anyone jumps to defend it, let's be clear about something upfront. [Republicans started this escalation.](https://substack.com/redirect/1b65a1e1-15fa-42f9-8682-2e214cc4b222?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Texas, Indiana, and other states have aggressively tried to redraw maps to lock in power and pick up seats. That is part of how we got here.
The response from Democrats is if you're going to do it, we're going to do it too. And on a tactical level, I understand it. You don't just sit there and let the other side stack the deck without responding.
The problem is what that leads to.
Because when both sides are playing this game, the only thing that actually loses is our representation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b67b1fc0-2dad-407f-be87-b6d7e56e7e8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
What the Republicans are Thinking Right Now
* * *
## Gerrymandering Was Always a Problem.
Gerrymandering isn't new. It goes back over 200 years to Elbridge Gerry, who signed off on a district so absurdly shaped that it was compared to a salamander. That's where the term comes from. Gerry's Salamander. Gerrymander.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3abad89e-c3e4-4e3b-85e2-44ff1c75ec0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[The OG Gerrymandered district](https://substack.com/redirect/a62cb178-e60c-4862-9081-2b2d03be855d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And since then, it has always been used for one purpose. To manipulate district lines in a way that gives one party an advantage in elections.
The difference now is precision.
Data and technology is better. You're no longer just drawing broad lines across counties. You're zooming in on neighborhoods, sometimes even down to individual blocks and houses, and carving out districts that guarantee outcomes. You can try it too with tool like [Dave's Redistricting.](https://substack.com/redirect/c3e9276a-e1be-48e7-b2a6-62b3fd5f1174?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
That's how you end up with districts like Illinois' 4th, nicknamed "the claw," or what's now being referred to now in Virginia as a "lobster" shaped district that stretches across completely disconnected regions just to group voters in a way that produces the desired result.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/52f4a7d3-6ebf-4131-b9f2-56ce33f187db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
## Virginia Was Already Close to Fair
What makes this situation frustrating is that Virginia wasn't wildly out of balance to begin with.
In the 2024 presidential election, the state went roughly 51.8 percent for Kamala Harris and about 46 percent for Donald Trump. The congressional delegation before this change was split 6 Democrats to 5 Republicans.
That's not extreme. If anything, that's fairly representative of a state that leans Democratic but is still competitive.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a8db89bc-b300-40c3-99e1-9c3e8fde95cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Virginia election results](https://substack.com/redirect/ad860def-594b-494d-8460-a267979fda38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Even if you wanted to argue for a slightly more Democratic tilt based on the gubernatorial race, you're talking about maybe 7-4\. What is being proposed now is not that.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/93d5c15a-fc2d-45de-8da8-ef144bd246ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
You're looking at potential outcomes like 9-1 or even 10-1, driven by maps that stretch across regions that have no logical connection.
* * *
## This Is the End Result of "Win at All Costs"
This is what happens when both parties fully commit to winning at all costs.
You stop trying to represent people, and you start trying to just win. You put voters into boxes, you isolate opposition, and you concentrate your own base into districts that guarantee outcomes. And once that happens across enough states, you don't have competitive elections anymore.
You have a handful of districts across the entire country that actually decide control of Congress. Everything else is predetermined.
When that happens, Congress stops functioning the way it's supposed to. We see that now! Because the real risk for most politicians is no longer losing to the other party. It's losing a primary. It's losing to someone more extreme within their own party. So there's no incentive to compromise, no incentive to work across the aisle, and no incentive to actually govern.
That's how you end up with a system that looks active but produces very little.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8d18c33a-4efd-4b6a-8534-04676d9bb385?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[WAPO](https://substack.com/redirect/786b755e-871d-4d40-aee1-d4ae0eb2ffbc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
## What Do We Do About It?...

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

| | | | **Imagine opening your retirement statement this year...**

And realizing that a simple decision - one most retirees never even think about - could reshape your taxes, your diversification, and even your long-term financial stability.

Every year, Americans over age 73 are forced to withdraw **tens of billions of dollars** from their retirement accounts. And year after year, most people follow the same path:

**Take the RMD in cash and move on.**

Not because it's the best choice.

But because no one ever tells them there's another way.

[The "Default" RMD Isn't Your Only Option.](https://links.research.firstinvestmentupdates.com/u/click?_t=6c5e8d0087884bb7b7cd2e3abb0e6b5f&_m=6583b09d45e44e02baf1c942f803b7ec&_e=tP5SvhTD6nAA3p0EzPJ6E4rTdsQdkxk6uDwfV70IEZgVjJ0dYvpqIqYYVwry6_E-Gy7qtTuEVJmRqyJi8-vO_IOjTokB4EZvxHtY2OGrrvd9r4aDWmgwcgIfkeDerG197IbG3b4mJZBAWAPZO7NyiBIWeAsf3OyH0ezsm3_qW8ZjfJTsT3Fl8npPTlZEyRzY9lCpdnMBfqwf02HfmjNCoc8qUCJo0BcDA97w9e9MbiD8xooxnEZYJwks1bSUYsNZuGSZjHgnClsQImyw-Z_z6jeJT0GHh2Fy27F3fp87NvIBABu9EGpnFatDHtmyDgB08mkDZRNPYk6AE3reY2hZHuIh1pdvOMipSMJ_MoxmZExzsoRIhVA0-pE9xtLc1mmBVzIyX-NEH0W85SIkzuqDP77Hj92koCFVop0UUJ3sqsd7jivMcci3DcTqIc_1lmcSgxICoeQ9K1HT2QiREnApWEuXJm6RDXHiDnuqcAcu2msUW9kb5CLfV6d1HeV17c-Y_lVk2SygekkDPmNbtnsIaqSpcVg71b1sdeIst5Kw2LdNm6_b6S3YxWsum1ou604rMxBePhFaIQabWMojpl5UZWX0772uhTZbqwno6f2CyQKbSaBaPN_tV_MvXEA9ZkON)

Financial institutions make it easy to withdraw cash. Too easy.

But simple isn't always strategic.

Taking your RMD in cash may:

* Increase taxable income
* Force you to sell assets at moments that may notalign with your plan
* Reduce the overall portion of your wealth that remains invested

And yet...

[There's an IRS-Approved Alternative Most Retirees Never Hear About.](https://links.research.firstinvestmentupdates.com/u/click?_t=6c5e8d0087884bb7b7cd2e3abb0e6b5f&_m=6583b09d45e44e02baf1c942f803b7ec&_e=tP5SvhTD6nAA3p0EzPJ6E4rTdsQdkxk6uDwfV70IEZgVjJ0dYvpqIqYYVwry6_E-Gy7qtTuEVJmRqyJi8-vO_IOjTokB4EZvxHtY2OGrrvd9r4aDWmgwcgIfkeDerG197IbG3b4mJZBAWAPZO7NyiBIWeAsf3OyH0ezsm3_qW8ZjfJTsT3Fl8npPTlZEyRzY9lCpdnMBfqwf02HfmjNCocTYZfTqrvlEOPdFjh2Yp4jJwJlAev4wd6xGg7uZoErY4Wo7K0UL6eo39VFwaDi5XXIuvjDuthVRkY1uPoetz4TAKpVSHZvlDeYslzNQSd4N0gmDM0_7wZ0_gqzPnzyODaW_agZ-DIGcGcBKRzQmkArAAIJmnHvMEDfqSVb7Ac6oCL4YXIFQRJ4zeu6pDpW1dh3j4m0uZCZX5tlRjej_s4ylfkcLwtGxq5SEsjxtzQ5pusBqvg95w37pxK1Zu-5WnSu8eTMaBhhBtkgmGI8a-S9CKc-K2uZdq8WH83PMKrG0-dpwNfWXc86iSmrp_avp7pmvXGj_Ynngb8KBR2zukJ7Lh6WRQT2ovSDOMr5EwvnDLQCGybDfRHomAXyORpC6syoFDANNt9GL_P9ev5I9STRMVTuHv70xj5qDjUZO5yLU)

Few realize that **RMDs can also be taken "in-kind."**

Meaning: instead of withdrawing cash, you can receive _certain assets directly_ without liquidating them first.

No, it doesn't eliminate taxes.

But for many savers, it may help them:

* Preserve their long-term allocation
* Avoid being forced to sell during volatile markets
* Strengthen diversification, depending on their strategy

It's fully IRS-allowed... but rarely mentioned in traditional planning conversations.

**Before You Take Your Next RMD, Ask Yourself:**

* Do I know _most_ IRS-approved ways to satisfy my distribution?
* Am I selling assets when I don't want to - or at prices I don't like?

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. Friend,
The other night, I took the stage alone at the KET debate. While my two main opponents chose to skip it,** I showed up – because I intend to earn every vote in this race to replace Mitch McConnell and fortify our MAGA Majority in the U.S. Senate.**
That’s not a talking point. It’s how we’re running this campaign across all of Kentucky’s 120 counties. My opponents have millions at their disposal, but they’ve been lighting it on fire to attack one another and play political games. We’ve instead tried to keep laser-focused on the issues that matter – the issues that put Republicans in power in 2024 in the first place.
**On that stage, I laid out exactly what I believe and exactly what I’ll fight for in Washington, D.C.**
I talked about **trust** \- _because people have a right to know their Senator will put their values first, not The Swamp or special interests. _I’ve spent my career fighting in the courtroom and in the statehouse for the rule of law, for life, and for the God-given rights our founders enshrined in the Constitution. That’s my track record, and it’s one I’ll carry straight to the Senate floor.
I talked about **standing firm** for the America First agenda that is already delivering results for working families._ We need to secure our border, finish the job President Trump started, and end the chaos that lets drugs, crime, and illegal crossings pour into our communities._ I laid out how I’ll support decisive action on national security - no forever wars, but real strength that prevents threats like a nuclear Iran before they reach our shores.
I spoke about the **kitchen-table issues** that matter most: _bringing down costs for gas, groceries, and energy; protecting our Second Amendment rights; ending the radical woke policies and DEI mandates that divide us; and making sure our kids get a real education, not indoctrination._
I reminded people that** farmers, coal miners, manufacturers, and small-business owners built the beautiful commonwealth I’m proud to call home** \- _and they deserve a Senator who fights for them every day._
Most importantly, I reminded everyone that this race is about **who will actually show up** when it matters.** I always have, and I always will.**
Judge me by my words and my record - _not by what my opponents say or don’t say_. **You’ll see a man who is proud to be a Christ-follower, a husband and father, and an American who puts faith, family, and freedom above everything else.**
But this fight is bigger than one debate. The Washington insiders and big-money interests don’t want a fighter like me in the Senate. They want someone who will go along to get along. That’s why I’m asking you today to stand with me.

That’s not a talking point. It’s how we’re running this campaign across all of Kentucky’s 120 counties. name: John Rich
subject: Help J6 veterans find justice
body:
I recently came across a striking statistic... 72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.

| | | [View this email in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsg1cv213ddm3df4r13bos9us5gojaiqi8j0ugh8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)

| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8f34lq5gtjesf45hnfqeeuc7ulv9qiv30o0nih8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztf5m29c07gs78nskd9ob8rtmoqpvp7btpoerhn8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)

Friend,

I recently came across a striking statistic.

**72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.**

And while courts often consider prior service as a factor for lighter sentences, the prosecutors and judges in these cases used their veteran or first responder status to argue for _**harsher penalties**_.

_Is this how our criminal justice system thanks them for their service?_

I’ve always honored those who serve. We are living the American dream _because_ of them. The way these patriots were treated is a grave injustice.

And while President Trump has pardoned almost all of the J6 defendants, they still haven’t received justice.

The lives and reputations of these patriots remain shattered from the lost years to the consistent government and mainstream media smear campaign they endured.

That’s why I’m proud to support Stand in the Gap.

This remarkable organization provides real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.

[If you believe in liberty, in due process, and in standing up for our fellow Americans, I hope you’ll make a donation to Stand in the Gap today. >>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z959rbt55jobngo5ihdk0qsiq68lhokoaqjnn150_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)
[Donate](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmo97oeou4fdq99cbt4bkj8hjjml0d9mm5hvte30_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)
Before January 6th, many of these patriots were unaware of just how broken the American justice system truly was.
Even after being pardoned, many J6 defendants still face...
* Difficulties finding a job
* Loss of rights, like the right to vote or the right to own a firearm
* Harassment on social media and in their personal lives
* Strained family relationships due to lost time in prison
* And even homelessness.

For many, returning to some semblance of a normal life is overwhelming.

**Stand in the Gap is committed to being a comprehensive support system for J6 defendants and their families by providing essential resources to help these American patriots heal physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually.**

Stand in the Gap believes in second chances, providing support to individuals transitioning back into society after incarceration, and working towards a more forward-thinking and restorative prison system that sends non-violent offenders into the world better off than they were when they went in.

Through their programs, partnerships, and advocacy efforts, they are making a lasting impact on the lives of those in need.

**There are nearly 1,600 Americans who are looking for a second chance.**

Let’s show these patriots they’re not forgotten.

[Will you help J6 defendants get back on their feet by donating $10, $35, $50, or even $100 to Stand in the Gap today? >>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7dqdtean1nqsrb9v6r1srfrfe7gq8cs2ue1un7g_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)
[Donate $10](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3rflul8hlg43h504i428jgct6rvhf647o9v0l0o_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)

[Donate $35](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhj6j4juma1vhja40qfj84u983djsbs0cs3d7lt0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)

[Donate $50](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmrp3sq8ejhibbamkq55bi69cajaqeaaqj5t55t0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)

[Donate $100](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi548rfss1b8vajfulc3qcr08nucgiliko6hk0h8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)

[Donate $250](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6cr2l7av7qna9d7egqd0gckrsgp2e7m98ma748g_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)

[Donate $500](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq72ju32dn4li0fmieudbkd8v969ffqerdkn6n3g_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)

[Donate $1,000](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5h6te10sb4t1e7ft1par5udgi6ni69jm50cdg20_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)

[Donate Any Amount](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8c4fkbu8iml3i4vshleqauv3o4l8rpcpbejad6g_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)
This isn’t about politics. It’s about justice.

These are real Americans — veterans, first responders, fathers, mothers, hard-working citizens — who exercised their First Amendment rights and were persecuted for their political beliefs.

_**If we don’t fight for our fellow patriots now, who will?**_

When you donate to Stand in the Gap, you’re not just defending individuals. _You are defending the soul of our country_.

**As long as there’s breath in my lungs and truth in my heart, I’ll be singing to honor veterans and first responders. I hope you’ll join me by taking action right now.**
[Donate](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqkk0csiqj2t7rvg2n3ckqik1165cmg9l1oamuj0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c1im8o73cph2bs)
For faith, freedom, and country,

John Rich
