name: David Hogg
subject: 🚨Endorsement alert 🚨
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Meet Jyot, Bentley, Ken, Armando, and Cat.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260424-1&t=1&akid=3404%2E587540%2EgY6f03)
Exciting news, Peter!
**Leaders We Deserve is officially endorsing:**
⭐ **Jyot Singh** for GA HD-97
⭐ **Bentley Hudgins** for GA HD-90
⭐ **Ken McCool** for NC HD-105
⭐ **Armando Montero** for AZ LD-12
⭐ **Cat Clayton** for MO HD-105
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260424_1_endorsements.5sCoG0&refcode=em20260424-3404&t=2&akid=3404%2E587540%2EgY6f03)
**Jyot Singh** grew up in the heart of Gwinnett County as the son of Punjabi immigrants, and has spent over a decade organizing Georgians. He knows firsthand what it looks like when the government fails working families: navigating life without healthcare, the anxiety of skyrocketing housing costs, and seeing school funding cut in the communities that need it most. Those experiences didn’t just shape the kind of candidate he is — _they’re his guiding light._ Jyot helped secure **$1.4 billion in funding for Gwinnett County Public Schools,** the largest education investment in the county’s history. He’s also spent _years_ doing civil rights advocacy for the South Asian community, working at the Federal Defender’s office.
**Jyot would be the first Sikh state legislator in Georgia’s history,** representing a district that has one of the fastest growing AAPI communities in the South. In Atlanta, he’ll fight to expand Medicaid, end the insurance industry’s game of frivolous claim denials and restrictive authorizations that keep care out of reach, keep housing accessible for the working families and immigrant communities that built Gwinnett into what it is, and stand tall against federal overreach to protect the rights and dignity of his neighbors.
Jyot’s main primary opponent in this race is anti-LGBTQ+ and anti-choice — so **District 97** is exactly the kind of seat that defines which direction Georgia goes. Jyot has spent his career delivering for this community, and **May 19** is the moment to send him to the Gold Dome to continue that work.
**[Split a Contribution](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260424_1_endorsements.5sCoG0&amount=5&refcode=em20260424-3404&t=3&akid=3404%2E587540%2EgY6f03)**
**Bentley Hudgins** has spent over a decade on the frontlines of Georgia politics. From registering hundreds of thousands of voters and **stopping over 35 anti-LGBTQ+ bills** as Georgia State Director for HRC to helping over **20,000 Georgians access COVID vaccines**. And when gun violence knocked on their own neighborhood’s door at Longdale Park, they built a community tracking system, brought the data to DeKalb County commissioners, and **secured $300,000 to clean up and revitalize the park.**
In Atlanta, Bentley will fight to expand Medicaid, pass the Georgia Civil Rights Act to protect against discrimination based on sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity, end ICE cooperation with local law enforcement, ban private prisons, and invest in the kind of community violence prevention that actually works.
**Bentley would be the first Japanese American and openly non-binary person ever to serve in the Georgia State Legislature.** And since **District 90** is one of the bluest districts in Georgia, winning the primary on **May 19** is critical. Bentley has what it takes to lead Georgia in a new direction — we just have to get them there.
**[Split a Contribution](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260424_1_endorsements.5sCoG0&amount=5&refcode=em20260424-3404&t=4&akid=3404%2E587540%2EgY6f03)**
**Ken McCool** made history when he became one of the youngest elected officials in North Carolina’s history at 21 years old. Since then, he’s served as Mayor Pro Tem, **expanding affordable housing options** , **securing the largest park investment in Matthews' town history** , and helping recruit the Hendrick Advanced Manufacturing Campus, **bringing in high-paying jobs and new industry to the region.**
In Raleigh, he’ll fight to lower costs for working families, protect reproductive rights, and make sure Mecklenburg County gets its fair share of investment in education, transit, and public safety.
Ken will face off with incumbent Tricia Cotham, a Democrat turned Republican who cast the deciding vote to restrict abortion access in North Carolina and won her seat by just 206 votes in 2024. **District 105** is competitive, but winnable, and Ken has spent his career proving that good government is about showing up and delivering for your constituents. That’s why he’ll win.
**[Split a Contribution](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260424_1_endorsements.5sCoG0&amount=5&refcode=em20260424-3404&t=5&akid=3404%2E587540%2EgY6f03)**
**Armando Montero** grew up in Tempe as a proud product of Arizona’s public schools. When the state legislature spent years attacking those same schools, he decided to take action. At just 19 years old, he made history as the youngest person ever elected to the Tempe Union High School District Governing Board. In his first year, he led the adoption of a **groundbreaking mental health policy** that transformed how the district delivers services to students. He rose to Board President where he **improved teacher pay and retention** , **helped the district earn an A rating from the Arizona Department of Education** , and continued to fight to protect the schools and students his state legislature left behind.
In Phoenix, he’ll fight to fully fund public schools, expand affordable housing options, tackle Arizona’s growing water crisis, and make healthcare accessible for working families.
Armando’s approach to public service and dedication to delivering for Arizonans is exactly what the state legislature needs more of. **LD-12** is one of the seats Democrats need to flip in the Arizona House, and with Armando’s deep community ties and proven track record, he’s built to win it.
**[Split a Contribution](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260424_1_endorsements.5sCoG0&amount=5&refcode=em20260424-3404&t=6&akid=3404%2E587540%2EgY6f03)**
**Cat Clayton** isn’t a career politician — and that’s her strength. As a software and data engineer, she’s spent her career **solving complex problems through careful analysis and collaboration.** She grew up watching Missouri’s GOP supermajority overturn citizen ballot initiatives like paid sick leave and now the abortion rights amendment, push extremism into classrooms, and ignore the will of the people. It was then that she decided the only way to fix what’s broken in Missouri government was to put her problem solving skills to use and change the system from the inside.
In Jefferson City, she’ll fight to strengthen public schools, lower costs for working families, protect reproductive rights, and approach government with a sense of transparency and accountability.
Democrats lost **HD-105** by just 898 votes in 2024. Breaking Missouri’s GOP supermajority depends on democrats winning in districts exactly like this one — and Cat’s fresh perspective, analytical approach, and deep roots in the community make her exactly the candidate to flip it.
**[Split a Contribution](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260424_1_endorsements.5sCoG0&amount=5&refcode=em20260424-3404&t=7&akid=3404%2E587540%2EgY6f03)**
Every candidate I’ve talked about today is a courageous fighter who has what it takes to lead our Democratic Party in a new direction. And they have something else in common: They don’t take a dime from corporate PACs or special interests. They answer to the people they serve. They are powered entirely by grassroots supporters like you. _And that’s what makes them worth fighting for._
**[Will you split a $5 contribution between Leaders We Deserve, Jyot, Bentley, Ken, Armando, and Cat today?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260424_1_endorsements.5sCoG0&refcode=em20260424-3404&amount=5&t=8&akid=3404%2E587540%2EgY6f03)**
**[Split a $5 Contribution »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260424_1_endorsements.5sCoG0&amount=5&refcode=em20260424-3404&t=27&akid=3404%2E587540%2EgY6f03)**
Thank you,
David Hogg

* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/?t=29&akid=3404%2E587540%2EgY6f03)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/signup/update-your-information/)

Friend,

No one likes asking for help. Most of us have worked hard all our lives to be self-sufficient and provide for our families.

But for our January 6 patriots still waiting on pardons -- good individuals who answered the call to peacefully protest a stolen election -- the last five-plus years have been nothing short of a nightmare.

Luckily, **the Trump Department of Justice has rightly asked the court to vacate the charges and convictions against the unpardoned Proud Boys and Oath Keepers leaders** and dismiss the cases with prejudice.

After years of weaponized prosecutions under the Biden regime, this is the right step toward real justice.

**But a new threat has emerged -- not from the DOJ, but from the radical left in Congress.**

Congressman Jamie Raskin -- one of the most partisan Democrats in Washington -- filed an amicus brief in three separate appeals in the D.C. Circuit to defend the original jury verdicts.

**Our side 's attorneys had to drop everything and work around the clock all weekend to draft a strong opposition brief! **

The filing deadline is extremely tight -- early this week.

These patriots have been completely financially drained after more than five years of brutal legal battles, imprisonment, and persecution. Many are veterans who served our country honorably, only to be treated like enemies of the state by their own government. They simply do not have the resources to fund this critical fight on their own while still dealing with other lingering issues.

**Stand in the Gap has stepped in to raise emergency funds so their legal team can file a powerful response -- on time and with strength.**

That is why we need your help today, Friend.

Our goal is to raise at least $120,000 this week to defend the 12 individuals involved.

Every dollar you give helps protect the rule of law, push back against leftist interference, and stand in the gap for these American patriots.

[Please help us fight this battle by donating today.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=13dff3ab97b445fe9f3590f4e978b00a&_e=FHqe9HTniICEtuQGTxtCqWmmlY0NsdNFITEjsSGnSNKDkOHbVYtPa5LAGaog8YyNha07_qBQV4Z4HnHPiqLG1-_qrXNKRKlxK7Sf8QRk_R5LCDYslvXWCUHG5RBO-8p2n16cEY_ZthBgcPr5VSYDzZscI2WMeiXsfp-JuWM0MAsWxhmI3b6p-PfMjwZGw8svhEX09iZ1QoJsCJLlGf1SxildkHoae49fSD_XA6i0uE_AB2Oe6CSzrQru6ZV1Q88Gf3Mik23o_BW6F9WmDSL3vd77LHADJCnRNMoCEDm1Ac4RsJOIPvOtvIg6G4IUfV6GdwkEeMWkZckt1qoGuduTtHfh-4rCxB004BUalgDr0mjgfkpiZ0TDshnZZFBi_T5oDXEuvq42_6MSnJdXc76h36k1FTy_QaBfh-d7liGUDs_-4r8pOMMdvhSHY4sgsjF5sRf9yp4HfTSCyZh_LMSH5YcCGDSrNtbIekOva4ugrRWnn3a2Bm_rcgu0fcnIcISlyU8NxCD6ETulR9NRC7FGic2Z6T3MsvdEJLtuK6t71ocrg83FUJ0keNjgIw3UlhRYCsXNj0hhln6ezGCj9ChxGxWC52BK9Jy-sMljmgG8oDsRZJytZS6WOL7y1zVHhtcn) Or keep reading to learn exactly who these individuals are -- many of them veterans -- why they were unfairly targeted, and why this fight matters to every conservative who believes in fairness and justice.

[Donate](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=13dff3ab97b445fe9f3590f4e978b00a&_e=FHqe9HTniICEtuQGTxtCqWmmlY0NsdNFITEjsSGnSNKDkOHbVYtPa5LAGaog8YyNha07_qBQV4Z4HnHPiqLG1-_qrXNKRKlxK7Sf8QRk_R5LCDYslvXWCUHG5RBO-8p2n16cEY_ZthBgcPr5VSYDzZscI2WMeiXsfp-JuWM0MAsCWgcoXJ2ACByBov-ggxiKs548alLvZO8xW5EnSbR5dMsOYeo9wAFFgrztMI-X3EqcKzqDptsxMBNyQdcCKCTMOrrKZNuGJ9DV6E1RwWf9q3GSfYIKsp9mGd7rV5a2O8CQfeWsthngkfK0n6ei7AJr7O8j4uaQfOVezbFGRRfM4ZQXbQVgczQxRuL-NFjAT6kUY_8HWuAHhcls-4-P_fEfeh7uMroQu8-BfCQyo_7KR3Ff5vSlUuuxohud7zyBH6-NWQmYzK8yEIb66bwB2vQQ0IZ0fj7fP5wP64fiBZbNvGdzYtBgxeFMzNcAzkrAs8vpmALDok2E12ksLYLrkWEwnpkDyl2oGt7-Un91_cnFgC0bmapvAvjNJbOGtIVHHmzNCYXmXuVJvl_P5GdWTSlivjOwR_WE5sckoTPZeTYmUlk53-3bY8CCT53gu8rLWFKLP2hvsdGRt0X2LXA-seqnttpfG5-MEOgHCBCwqY5c4A%3D%3D)

**These were the patriots that the Biden DOJ pursued the hardest with politically charged trials. **
* **Stewart Rhodes (Veteran),** founder and leader of the Oath Keepers, was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 18 years in prison.
* **Kelly Meggs** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 12 years.
* **Kenneth Harrelson (Veteran)** was convicted of related felony charges and sentenced to 4 years.
* **Jessica Watkins (Veteran)** was convicted of related felony charges and sentenced to 8.5 years.
* **Roberto Minuta,** Edward Vallejo (Veteran), Joseph Hackett, and David Moerschel were all convicted of seditious conspiracy after their own months-long trial and received substantial prison sentences with federal terrorism enhancements.
* **Ethan Nordean** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 18 years.
* **Joseph Biggs (Veteran)** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 17 years.
* **Zachary Rehl (Veteran)** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 15 years.
* **Dominic Pezzola (Veteran)** was convicted of serious felony charges in the same case and sentenced to 10 years.

These individuals should never have been targeted with inflated seditious conspiracy charges in the first place.

Now, the Trump administration is finally moving to correct this injustice and vacate the convictions.

**But Raskin is fighting tooth and nail to stop it. **

He is demanding the court appoint a special lawyer (an independent amicus) to oppose the DOJ and defend the old jury verdicts -- _essentially trying to keep the deep state 's narrative alive and continue punishing these patriots_.

**This need is especially urgent.**

A bombshell
report reveals Chief Justice John Roberts helped build the Supreme Court’s
“shadow docket” — a backdoor process for major rulings with no full
briefing, no arguments, and often no explanation.

What started as a rarely used emergency tool has been transformed into a
quiet pipeline for reshaping the law out of public view.

And under Trump, it’s been weaponized.

When Trump gets blocked in lower courts for breaking the law or pushing
unconstitutional policies, he runs straight to the Supreme Court demanding
an “emergency” order.

And this Court delivers:

30+ requests.
~80% success rate.

These are supposed to be temporary rulings. They’re not.

Immigrants lose protections. Civil servants get pushed out. Limits on
presidential power disappear all through unsigned, late-night orders with
no explanation.

Roberts set this precedent. Now it’s the playbook.

The bottom line is: this Court is operating without transparency,
accountability, or the restraint our democracy demands — and it won’t
change on its own.

Demand Justice PAC is exposing these abuses and building public and
political pressure needed to force reform — from ethics rules to
structural changes that rein in this out-of-control Court. But that
pressure only works if we can scale it.

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/s3rba65b835)**
| | Happy Friday!
Yesterday, we announced our first speaker for the RMV Freedom Festival!
**👉[Nick Shirley — Keynote Speaker at the Mountain Majesty Gala](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/ser97703782)**
Today, we want to share a little more about why we chose him.
Nick Shirley is part of a new wave of independent journalists—focused on going directly to the source, asking real questions, and documenting what’s actually happening on the ground.
His investigations into fraud and government accountability have sparked national attention, not because they follow a narrative—but because they show people what’s really happening. Directly from the source, going right into the heart of corruption.
That approach aligns perfectly with what we’re building at Rocky Mountain Voice. We believe Colorado deserve more transparency, more firsthand reporting, and fewer filtered stories. And we believe Colorado isn't far off from some of the stories Nick is reporting on... [Um, hello autism therapy billing red flags?????](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/s5mcaec72c0)
Freedom Festival is designed to bring together voices like this—alongside leaders, organizers, and thousands of engaged Coloradans—just days before the primary.
You can read the full article on **[WHY we chose Nick Shirley](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/s6m2e62805b)** and what this event is all about below, or [click here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/s9i5b36a219).
🎟️ [Tickets are now available! Get yours here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/s0jdd238e44)
More speaker announcements are coming soon.
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/s1mf50f70cf), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/s4v09b2fbb7) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/scu809e934e).
This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, April 24, 2026.
– Team RMV

__From the U.S.–Mexico border to government-run facilities to communities dealing with policy fallout, he shows up with a camera, asks direct questions, and lets people speak for themselves. **[Weiser’s record: 27,000 complaints. 17 settlements.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/s8v18711d5c)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/sbp2e761e9c)
* **Complaints surge while enforcement lags:** Colorado received nearly 27,000 consumer complaints in 2025—up sharply from 2019—but the attorney general’s office produced just 17 settlements or judgments, far below its target.
* **Growing gap between workload and results:** Data shows one enforcement action for every 1,588 complaints, a significant decline from prior years, even as investigations remain steady and laws have been expanded to strengthen consumer protections.
* **Transparency and accountability questions raised:** The office has cited resource limits and relies on a mediation program with limited public reporting, while also declining to release certain aggregate data, prompting scrutiny over performance and use of available funds.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/sakb97178dd)**

**[A missing email and a federal paper trail: Colorado weighs discipline in Guggenheim case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/s8q7fdeae6c)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-LA/s0p5eb7a099)
* **Dispute centers on missing email in disciplinary case:** State employee Rich Guggenheim claims an email exists directing him to approve a USDA report, while the Colorado Department of Agriculture says no such email exists, making it a key unresolved issue in his potential discipline.
* **Federal report timeline raises additional questions:** Records show the report went through multiple submissions and revisions before final approval, including the removal of DEI-related training references, which Guggenheim had flagged as a concern.
* **Transparency and process concerns emerge:** The case involves disputed CORA records requests, withheld documents, and conflicting accounts, with Guggenheim on paid leave and pursuing complaints through multiple state and federal channels as a final decision remains pending.

Peter,

At an early age, Gina’s grandmother taught her an important lesson: _No te dejes. Fight back_. It’s a lesson that Gina has carried with her for her entire life — and it’s what she’s doing today as she runs to be the next Governor of Texas.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260424_1_bio.1UtRET&refcode=em20260424-986&amount=5&t=2&akid=986%2E299639%2EEyeb5g)_Born and raised in the Valley_
Gina never planned to run for office. But when her son’s elementary school was threatened for closure by state budget cuts, she rallied other parents, ran for Austin ISD School Board, and won. She kept her son’s school open, along with every other public school in the district.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260424_1_bio.1UtRET&refcode=em20260424-986&amount=5&t=3&akid=986%2E299639%2EEyeb5g)_The Austin Chronicle endorsed her race for school board_
But neighborhood schools kept closing across the state because Republican leaders kept diverting Texas tax dollars away from schools. So Gina ran for a seat in the Texas House of Representatives — and she won. In 2019, she helped win an investment of more than $11 billion in Texas public schools.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260424_1_bio.1UtRET&refcode=em20260424-986&amount=5&t=4&akid=986%2E299639%2EEyeb5g)_On the floor of the Texas State House_
**Now, Gina is the official Democratic nominee running to unseat Greg Abbott.** She’s been winning tough fights for her entire life, and she has what it takes to do it again this November.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260424_1_bio.1UtRET&refcode=em20260424-986&amount=5&t=5&akid=986%2E299639%2EEyeb5g)_Years later, she’s still fighting back. No te dejes._
A new poll shows Gina tied with Abbott — in a district he last won by 10 points.
That means we have the momentum behind us, but with only six months until Election Day, Gina’s relying on your urgent support to scale up her campaign before it’s too late.

| | **My deepest condolences remain with the families of the 67 lives lost in the DCA mid-air tragedy.** This month, the House overwhelmingly passed the Airspace Location and Enhanced Risk Transparency (ALERT) Act of 2026. This bill is part of a comprehensive legislative response I co-led in the wake of the tragic 2025 mid-air collision at DCA. The bipartisan ALERT Act is the result of productive, good-faith collaboration and incorporates feedback from the NTSB and the aviation community to make it a truly comprehensive safety bill. Its passage is the next step in delivering on Congress's safety commitment to the flying public and acting on the NTSB's 50 safety recommendations. I look forward to working with my Senate counterparts to get a final bill to the President's desk. Here's what aviation and safety stakeholder groups are saying about the ALERT Act: **_National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB):_**_"We thank Chairman Graves, Ranking Member Larsen, Chairman Rogers, and Ranking Member Smith for meeting with the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) over the last several weeks. We are grateful that they have sought out, seriously considered, and accepted the NTSB's technical assistance to better understand and implement our recommendations from the final report on the investigation."_ **_Affordable Skies Coalition:_**_"The Affordable Skies Coalition supports passage of the Airspace Location and Enhanced Risk Transparency (ALERT Act). August 8, 2009, is a date I will never forget.
Just days before his 19th birthday, my son Justin was out in the fields with us, doing what this family has done for over three generations—farming the Louisiana delta. A breakdown in our combine left corn spilled across the ground, and as we worked to recover it, Justin got too close. In an instant, his pant leg was caught, and the thresher pulled him in.
I can still hear his voice: “Dad, get me out.”
And there was nothing I could do.

I’ve always been fascinated by how our democracy works.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3161%2E21716%2E0I3NDz)
Let's just get this out of the way: I'm a nerd.
I’ve been called it enough in my life that I’ve just got to embrace it — _I’m the built-the-Capitol-out-of-Legos, can’t-resist-a-random-history-fact kind of nerd._
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260424-1.clSHsw&refcode=em20260424-3161&t=2&akid=3161%2E21716%2E0I3NDz)
(I’ve also built the White House out of Legos. It’s a whole thing.)
Did you know that the ballroom at the Hotel du Pont in Wilmington is where Joe Biden celebrated his first Senate win in 1972? Because I did. And I will absolutely tell you about it at length if you let me.
But here’s the thing: I’ve always been this way. I’ve always been fascinated by how our democracy works — how ordinary people, through public service, can actually make lives better.
And now, I get to take that lifelong love of history and turn it into action in Congress — fighting for unions and teachers, fighting for paid leave and an economy that works for working families.
The nerd is in the building, and I’m rolling up my sleeves and working hard every day, but I’m counting on your support to stay focused on advocating and legislating.
[**Will you pitch in $5 now to fuel my work in Congress?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260424-1.clSHsw&refcode=em20260424-3161&amount=5&t=3&akid=3161%2E21716%2E0I3NDz)
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260424-1.clSHsw&amount=5&refcode=em20260424-3161&t=4&akid=3161%2E21716%2E0I3NDz)**
We’re facing real challenges. You know it and I know it.
Donald Trump and Republicans are pushing extreme policies that hurt the very people they’re supposed to represent. They’re trying to distract, divide, and derail progress, but I’m pushing back and I’m working on delivering results.
So yes, I geek out about government. And yes, I still have Lego sets at home. But what fuels me is our shared belief that public service can be a force for good — and that we can build something better, together.
[**If you believe in the work I’m doing, I could use your help. Please chip in $5 or whatever you can now.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260424-1.clSHsw&refcode=em20260424-3161&amount=5&t=5&akid=3161%2E21716%2E0I3NDz)

Thank you!
— Sarah

##### APRIL 24, 2026 | DERELICTIONS DOSSIER | VOLUME 4
### **THE CORE CHARGE**
A home is more than a roof and four walls. It is the foundation of family, the anchor of community, and the first measure of the American dream. That foundation is now being dismantled--not by market forces, but by a deliberate framework of federal rules designed to make affordability impossible and civic action irrelevant.
The Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), and the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) have built an **Architecture of Scarcity**. Its purpose is control. Its product is poverty. Its proof is in the 2026 collapse: a **93% plunge in Americans moving to Florida** and a market where **77% of homes sell at a loss**. Its method is legislative silence, killing popular relief bills.
This is not market failure. It is policy failure by design.
Faced with this engineered crisis, the political establishment offers only **" managerial surrender"**--diagnosing the problem while offering subsidies and procedural tweaks that manage the symptoms, never striking the root. This surrender has a human cost beyond dollars: it is the loss of your voice, your agency, and your power to shape the future of your community.
This document is not a white paper. It is an indictment. It enters into evidence the specific regulations, their human cost, the theft of civic power, and the single legislative remedy that can dismantle this structure: the **Regulations from the Executive in Need of Scrutiny (REINS) Act**.
The charge is dereliction. The verdict is yours.
* * *
### **I. The Blueprint - How Federal Rules Built the Crisis and Broke Environmental Protection**
This is not a dry policy debate. It is a live war over who controls the ground beneath your home and the future of Florida's environment--a war the federal bureaucracy is winning by paralyzing both.
* * *
**The Florida Model: How Real Stewardship Works**
Before detailing the federal failure, understand the proven alternative: **local accountability**. Florida's history shows that engaged citizens and responsive state government are the most effective guardians of our land and water.
* **Florida State Parks (2024 -2025):** Public outrage--not federal lawsuits--forced the withdrawal of plans for golf courses and hotels in nine state parks, leading to the **Florida State Park Preservation Act**.
* **Okeechobee Data Center (2026):** A proposal threatening waterways was scrapped after a single, well-attended public hearing and direct community pressure.
* **Withlacoochee State Forest (2025):** A developer's land swap on protected forest land was halted by public backlash.

In each case, **direct citizen engagement with accountable state government** produced better environmental outcomes than any federal lawsuit or rule ever could. This is effective stewardship: transparent, local, and decisive. The federal model replaces this with slow-motion legal paralysis.
* * *
**The Federal Permitting War (2020 -2026): A Case Study in Failure**
In 2020, Florida took over the federal "Section 404" wetland permitting program to streamline approvals under clear, state-run rules. It worked. Permits moved faster; projects advanced with state oversight.
Then, in 2024, a federal judge revoked that authority. The ruling stated the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) had acted illegally in the transfer. The result: **over 1,000 pending permits** were thrown back into the sluggish federal bureaucracy. Projects stalled. Costs soared. The promise of efficient, accountable state control was broken by distant federal decree.
This is the **Architecture of Scarcity** in action. It is designed for control, not outcomes; for paralysis, not protection.
* * *
**How Federal Overreach Fails on All Fronts**
The federal framework does not just raise costs--it actively creates the conditions for failure.
* **HUD 's Affirmatively Furthering Fair Housing (AFFH) Rule:** This rule leverages federal grants to pressure municipalities into top-down zoning changes, triggering lawsuits and community dissent that stall construction for years.
* _**Environmental Impact:**_ By paralyzing dense, transit-friendly urban infill, AFFH **incentivizes sprawl** --pushing development to greenfields, increasing car dependence, carbon emissions, and habitat loss.
* **EPA 's "Waters of the United States" (WOTUS) Rule:** An expansive, vague definition turns dry land into "federally protected wetlands," halting projects outright.
* **Environmental Impact:** The litigation glut creates **paralysis, not protection**. Resources drain into courtrooms instead of conservation, while the push to exurban areas degrades untouched ecosystems.
* **FHFA and the GSEs ' Credit Overlays:** The Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) directs Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac (Government-Sponsored Enterprises, or GSEs) to enforce rigid national mortgage standards.
* **Economic Impact:** This acts as a **de facto credit tax** , locking out first-time buyers and strangling capital for multi-family construction.
* **The Cumulative "Soft Cost" Burden:** Layer these federal rules with state and local mandates, and the result is a **regulatory surcharge of up to 30%** on the final price of a new home.

* * *
**The 2026 Verdict**
This architecture was built to constrain supply. Its success is catastrophic. Demand has collapsed--a 93% plunge in Americans moving to Florida. The market is recoiling--77.5% of homes now sell below their asking price. And the proven model of local, accountable stewardship is sidelined by federal failure.
* * *
### **II. The Human Cost - Evidence from District 11**
The Architecture of Scarcity is not an abstract policy failure. It is a lived experience of financial ruin, broken dreams, and, most insidiously, the theft of civic power from the people it claims to serve.
* * *
**A. The 2026 Collapse: Statewide Proof**
The data from the first quarter of 2026 proves the crisis is not coming--it is here.
* **The Great American Exodus:** U.S. Census Bureau data reveals net domestic migration into Florida has collapsed from 310,892 Americans in 2022 to just **22,517 in 2025 --a 93% decline**.
* **The Market Correction:** Zillow data for February-March 2026 shows the Florida housing market in retreat: a **Median Sale to List Ratio of 0.967** and **77.5% of homes selling below their list price**.

**What this means:** The market has completely flipped. A Sale-to-List Ratio below 1.0 means homes are selling for less than asking. With 77.5% of homes selling below list price, it's clear that **demand has collapsed** and home values are falling.
This is not a market adjustment. It is the direct, measurable consequence of an engineered scarcity.
* * *
**B. Case Study: The Apopka Town Hall - A Constituent Ignored**
In April 2025, with the housing and insurance crisis accelerating, constituents in Apopka gathered to seek answers and solutions. Their representative was absent. The event became a raw display of the human cost. One attendee polled the room: _" How many of you got a letter from your insurance company saying you've been dropped or your premium has been raised?"_ A sea of hands rose. This moment connected the property insurance crisis--itself a product of federal risk models and failed policies--directly to kitchen-table terror. The event's central, shouted question--_**" Where is Daniel Webster?"**_--symbolized the deeper betrayal: a refusal by those in power to even face the citizens living with the consequences of the system they uphold.
* * *
**C. The Deeper Wound: The Loss of Civic Agency**
The human cost extends beyond dollars. It is the **loss of your voice and your power**. The federal rules documented in Part I replace Florida's proven model of local accountability--where citizens can rally, protest, and directly influence outcomes--with a distant, unaccountable bureaucracy. You cannot petition a federal rule. You cannot vote out a HUD appointee. This system **actively disempowers you** , breeding the cynicism that asks, "Why bother?" This erosion of civic duty is the ultimate victory of managerial surrender.
* * *
**D. Your Evidence - The Battle Plan**
This dossier is a living document. The final piece of evidence must come from you.
1. **Gather Your Evidence:** Document the real-world impact. Save the insurance non-renewal letter. Photograph the zoning notice.
2. **Personalize the Cost:** How did it affect your family? Did you delay starting a family? Cancel a retirement plan?
3. **Send Me the Proof:** Submit your evidence to **[evidence@americankitchentable.com](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3ac26443-c567-40dd-b74a-14d7296bf604?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.

We will track every submission and publish the findings in subsequent War Room Dispatches. This is how we turn pain into power--by building an irrefutable, citizen-driven record.
* * *
### **III. The Doctrine of Managerial Surrender**
The incumbent's record reveals a consistent philosophy: when confronted with systemic failure, address the paperwork, not the power structure. This is **Managerial Surrender**. It is the act of diagnosing a crisis while offering only the bureaucratic equivalent of aspirin--treating the fever while ignoring the infection. His career is a case study in this doctrine.
* * *
**Exhibit A: The FISHES Act - Managing the Symptom.**
When Florida's fisheries are crippled by federal catch shares, seasonal closures, and habitat designations, the response is not to challenge the regulatory overreach. It is to file for disaster relief. H.R. 5103, the FISHES Act, seeks to streamline _aid payments_ after the bureaucratic disaster has already struck. It manages the symptom of delay. It does not cure the disease of top-down control that creates the disaster. This is the model: respond to the _consequence_ of bad policy, never the _cause_.
* * *
**Exhibit B: The Hollow Promise - "Get Government Out of the Way."**
In 2020, Daniel Webster promised to 'remove unnecessary government red-tape.' His core political principle remains 'Get government out of the way.' Yet the 'Architecture of Scarcity' documented in this dossier is the very government he claims to oppose. The HUD, EPA, and FHFA rules are the embodiment of that red tape. His legislative solution? Not the root-cause REINS Act, but more managerial adjustments at the edges.
* * *
**Exhibit C: The 2026 State-Level Surrender - A Failure of Influence.**
In early 2026, as the housing crisis peaked, the Florida House of Representatives acted.
* **HB 657,** the "Homeowners' Association Dissolution and Accountability Act," passed by a landslide **108-to-2 vote**.
* **HJR 203,** a constitutional amendment to eliminate non-school property taxes for homesteads, passed **80 to 30**.

Both were popular, bipartisan responses to the crisis. Both died without a vote in the Florida Senate, where Webster's party holds a supermajority.
This is not a direct vote he cast. It is a **failure of influence and priority.** As a senior Florida congressman, he possesses a platform and relationships in Tallahassee. Had he used his voice to champion complementary federal root-cause reform (like the REINS Act), he could have created pressure and political cover for state allies to pass these bills. Instead, his federal silence mirrored the state's procedural surrender. He did not "get government out of the way"; he watched it stand in the way.

Following the angry town hall documented in Part II, his office issued a newsletter. It expressed "concern" about insurance costs and listed his efforts to "work with FEMA." It did not mention his inaction on Risk Rating 2.0, the unconstitutional algorithm at the root of the crisis. It did not call for the REINS Act. It was a **" Paper Shield"**--a performative gesture that offers the appearance of action while providing no actual defense against the underlying threat.
* * *

The FISHES Act manages disaster aid, not the regulations causing the disaster. His "get government out of the way" principle is hollow against his record of inaction on the rules _in_ the way. The death of state-level housing relief reveals a failure to leverage his influence for tangible results. The Apopka newsletter performs concern without proposing a cure.
The dereliction is this: He identifies the symptom (regulatory burden), but his prescribed remedy is always a **managerial adjustment** to live with the disease, never a **legislative strike** to cure it. He has surrendered the constitutional duty of a legislator--to make and unmake law--in favor of managing the bureaucracy that has replaced it.
* * *
### **IV. The Legislative Strike - The REINS Act**
This section presents the solution not as another managerial adjustment, but as a structural strike at the root of power.
**Mechanism:** The REINS Act (Regulations from the Executive in Need of Scrutiny Act) requires that any "major rule" (with an economic impact of $100M+) from a federal agency like HUD, EPA, or FHFA must be approved by a joint resolution of Congress before taking effect.
**Impact:** It restores the constitutional chain of consent. No longer can an agency rule that adds thousands to the cost of a home or blocks an apartment complex take effect without a direct, on-the-record vote by the people's representatives. **It would have forced a vote on HUD 's AFFH Rule, EPA's WOTUS definition, and FHFA's Credit Overlays.**

It would have forced a vote on the rules that made HOA dissolution necessary (HB 657) or property tax relief urgent (HJR 203). Instead of managing the symptoms of agency overreach, it returns the power to cure the disease to the people's representatives. It shifts the fight from managing scarcity to enabling abundance.
* * *
### **CONCLUSION: A CHOICE OF FUTURES**
The evidence is incontrovertible. An unaccountable federal bureaucracy has constructed a system--an **Architecture of Scarcity** --that makes the foundational act of American life, securing a home, mathematically impossible for working families. The data from 2026 proves the collapse is underway.
The incumbent's response has been a philosophy of **Managerial Surrender** : acknowledging the crisis while offering only paperwork and palliatives. He issues newsletters of concern as property taxes skyrocket. He files for disaster relief for fisheries strangled by federal rules but will not challenge the rules themselves. He watches as popular, bipartisan housing reforms die in a state legislature controlled by his own party, offering no root-cause solution from his federal office.
This is more than a failed policy record. It is a **dereliction of the fundamental duty of representation** : to wield public power to secure public good.
Therefore, the voters of Florida's 11th District face a binary choice between two futures:
**PATH A: MANAGERIAL SURRENDER.** Accept the continued delegation of your power to distant agencies. Resign yourself to a future of subsidies, means-tested programs, and managed decline. Watch as your voice in your community is replaced by a federal docket number.
**PATH B: STRIKE THE ROOT.** Reclaim the legislative power ceded to the administrative state. Pass the **REINS Act** to force Congress to be accountable for the rules that govern your life. Dismantle the Architecture of Scarcity and restore the conditions for building, ownership, and genuine, citizen-driven stewardship of our communities and environment.
This campaign chooses Path B.
**The REINS Act is more than a bill; it is the mechanism to restore consent.** It does not ask you to trust a better manager. It demands that your representative become a true legislator again. He offers a Paper Shield of procedural tweaks. We propose to strike at the root.
It is my responsibility to expose this corruption of our constitutional order.
**It is your power to demand justice at the ballot box.**

Friend,

No one likes asking for help. Most of us have worked hard all our lives to be self-sufficient and provide for our families.

But for our January 6 patriots still waiting on pardons -- good individuals who answered the call to peacefully protest a stolen election -- the last five-plus years have been nothing short of a nightmare.

Luckily, **the Trump Department of Justice has rightly asked the court to vacate the charges and convictions against the unpardoned Proud Boys and Oath Keepers leaders** and dismiss the cases with prejudice.

After years of weaponized prosecutions under the Biden regime, this is the right step toward real justice.

**But a new threat has emerged -- not from the DOJ, but from the radical left in Congress.**

Congressman Jamie Raskin -- one of the most partisan Democrats in Washington -- filed an amicus brief in three separate appeals in the D.C. Circuit to defend the original jury verdicts.

**Our side 's attorneys had to drop everything and work around the clock all weekend to draft a strong opposition brief! **

The filing deadline is extremely tight -- early this week.

These patriots have been completely financially drained after more than five years of brutal legal battles, imprisonment, and persecution. Many are veterans who served our country honorably, only to be treated like enemies of the state by their own government. They simply do not have the resources to fund this critical fight on their own while still dealing with other lingering issues.

**Stand in the Gap has stepped in to raise emergency funds so their legal team can file a powerful response -- on time and with strength.**

That is why we need your help today, Friend.

Cassidy is an anti-abortion extremist. He will do anything he can to stop women from making their own private reproductive healthcare choices.

One day in October of 2018, I knocked on a door in a winding cul-de-sac in Troy.
The woman who answered was around my mom’s age. I introduced myself and I told her that I was running to be her State Senator. I handed her my literature, and she turned it over a few times.
“Are you married?” she asked.
_Yes_ , I told her. Then I pointed to the picture of my husband, Ray, and our dog in the literature.
“Do you have any kids?”
_No_ — we had just been married the year before at Eastern Market, right before I filed to run for office.
“Well, are you going to have kids? And when? And how many?”
She told me that her own daughter was pregnant and that it would be her first grandchild. Then she stopped me.
“I’m sorry,” she said. “I need to know that my senator is in the office representing me the whole time. I can’t vote for you. **This isn’t a job for a mom.** ”
I thought about her own daughter and how she needed an advocate, how she deserved a voice. Of course, women could do this. Of course, moms should do this.
But I want to admit something to you, Peter — this can get draining. You see, a few weeks ago was the dreaded gap between the last week of summer school and the first week of regular school for my daughter’s pre-school.
Somehow, my husband and I timed it _completely_ wrong. In trying to balance everything, we completely screwed up the dates. We found ourselves scrambling that week for child care, for someone to be with our brilliant and endlessly energetic four-year-old, so that we could maintain two full-time jobs on top of a statewide U.S. Senate campaign.
**So many women know that gap.**
I found myself worried about telling my campaign team, about stressing them out, thinking that they wished they worked for any other kind of candidate. One without a kid. One who doesn’t have to worry about who’s watching her young child, knowing how hard they worked to arrange a full schedule of fundraisers, meet and greets, union training facility tours, and events.
That week, I found myself deeply understanding why so many women just _quit_.
Peter, we do this work to write a New American Dream and to ensure that it’s not just some relic of the past.
We do all of this work knowing that it will mean time away from our families.
There will be weeks when you find yourself struggling to find childcare, where you want to tear your hair out. Weeks when you think so much about how much easier it would be to just quit.
But you don’t. **Because we matter.** Our voices matter. Because you know that you can make it easier for the next woman who comes after you. And because you know that there are so many people who know what you are going through and who have your back.

Friend,

I recently came across a striking statistic.

**72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.**

And while courts often consider prior service as a factor for lighter sentences, the prosecutors and judges in these cases used their veteran or first responder status to argue for _**harsher penalties**_.

_Is this how our criminal justice system thanks them for their service?_

I’ve always honored those who serve. We are living the American dream _because_ of them. The way these patriots were treated is a grave injustice.

And while President Trump has pardoned almost all of the J6 defendants, they still haven’t received justice.

The lives and reputations of these patriots remain shattered from the lost years to the consistent government and mainstream media smear campaign they endured.

That’s why I’m proud to support Stand in the Gap.

This remarkable organization provides real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.

[If you believe in liberty, in due process, and in standing up for our fellow Americans, I hope you’ll make a donation to Stand in the Gap today. >>](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkLGOpDAQRL_GZCDTBgOBg5NGZHPphaixG_CcMchuZn9_xUj7AZtWPZWe6t9zeqIPPq5_cSeTeJlSnjYK50u_iSlhzIuP7nVl9pYmkKBL2ZTQ3BwUzjjrsLYFmbrrOqnlIFWxmR50v9Sunp3SMLe2Hzo7WJpb2bu274fCm3tKNtCAlLUaKjXD0jpstesW6hWIRmKgxFWi85qDtxgZ8__lSJYqe-xFMBvzmYX6I2AUMGayV6IKI7mDb-LOGKMrfSx5o3LFU8B4YomW_RGFGi_eJ4v7iX6NQj1-jAToT3NEpshCPRIvRTLu_PIh-Kw70ch1Rx8-Hvz7194GvgMAAP__0q57Zw)

Before January 6th, many of these patriots were unaware of just how broken the American justice system truly was.
Even after being pardoned, many J6 defendants still face...
* Difficulties finding a job
* Loss of rights, like the right to vote or the right to own a firearm
* Harassment on social media and in their personal lives
* Strained family relationships due to lost time in prison
* And even homelessness.

For many, returning to some semblance of a normal life is overwhelming.

**Stand in the Gap is committed to being a comprehensive support system for J6 defendants and their families by providing essential resources to help these American patriots heal physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually.**

Stand in the Gap believes in second chances, providing support to individuals transitioning back into society after incarceration, and working towards a more forward-thinking and restorative prison system that sends non-violent offenders into the world better off than they were when they went in.

Through their programs, partnerships, and advocacy efforts, they are making a lasting impact on the lives of those in need.

**There are nearly 1,600 Americans who are looking for a second chance.**

Let’s show these patriots they’re not forgotten.

We need to talk to you about what just happened in Virginia. And we need you to understand exactly what it means for every state in this country, including yours.

**Virginia Democrats just passed a referendum to gerrymander 4 congressional seats away from Republicans.**

Four seats. Gone. Redrawn.

To make matters even worse, we offered to help organizations in Virginia fight this referendum. And we were denied! They did not want to support us financially.

Here's why this is important to you.

Virginia Governor Abigail Spanberger is already going on the news saying Democrats will do this in all 50 states the moment they win back the House.

All 50 states!

That is not a threat buried in a policy memo. That is an elected official -- the Governor of Virginia -- announcing the Left's playbook on the record. They are not hiding it anymore. Here is the truth:

If this is what Democrats are willing to do right now -- out of power, in a single state -- just imagine what they will do if they reclaim the White House and Congress.

So here is where we stand right now.

**Turning Point PAC is hiring 700 NEW ballot chasers to deploy across Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire -- the three states that will decide whether Republicans hold the House and win the presidency in 2028.**

Voters are fed up with our current health care system.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260424-6174-footer&t=1&akid=6174%2E420207%2EwkvBIk)
What a surprise, Peter. 🙄
The corporate-backed board of the _Washington Post_ — which is owned by Jeff Bezos — published an op-ed attacking me for pointing out the strengths of Cuba’s health care system.
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260424.cTj9eC&refcode=em20260424-6174&t=2&akid=6174%2E420207%2EwkvBIk)
The reality is the Cuban health care system has done so much with so little. They have some of the lowest infant and maternal mortality rates in the world, they developed their own COVID-19 vaccine, and their cancer detection rates are impressive.
And they’ve achieved all of it despite a US embargo.
**Meanwhile, the U.S. is funneling billions to health care CEOs while working people go without care—or go broke trying to get it.**
But when you look at the number of prominent conservatives on the _Washington Post’s_ editorial board, it’s clear why they felt compelled to come after me and attack Medicare For All: _they’re terrified it might actually happen._
Poll numbers show that voters are fed up with our current health care system. It’s the number one cost concern for Americans and a clear majority supports a program like Medicare For All.
Voters don’t want incremental changes. They want us to go big.
I’ll keep driving the fight for truly universal health care every single day—no matter what the conservative, corporate-backed editorial board of The Washington Post says.
[**If you’re with me, can I count on you to pitch in $3 to help me fight back against their attacks and build a health care system where everyone can get the care they need?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260424.cTj9eC&refcode=em20260424-6174&amount=3&t=3&akid=6174%2E420207%2EwkvBIk)

The State Party will provide the most important facts - a kernel of truth - from the week. = ** Important Early Voting Updates: Saturday Voting Opens. Have a Mail-In Ballot? Return It! We are just over 10 days away from the May 5 primary election, and we have some important reminders for you! If you requested a ballot by mail, please return it ASAP. Ballots by mail must be received by your county elections office by 6 PM on Election Day in order to count. Secondly, if you plan to take advantage of Saturday voting, that option opens in many of our state’s 92 counties tomorrow. In Marion County, new satellite early voting locations in each of the city’s nine townships. To find out full information about your county’s locations and hours, please visit today. Micah Beckwith Picks Fight With High School Band If you didn’t think things could get any lower for Indiana’s Lt. Governor Micah Beckwith, well you would be wrong. This week. Beckwith fired off a post critical of the Westfield High School Marching Band for playing violin compositions that he did not like. Beckwith even went as far as to call the performances “demonic”, and demand that more Hoosiers pull their kids out of public schools in Indiana. Instead of taking responsibility for the scandals in his own church and his state government, Beckwith is attacking high school students for learning new compositions and for being in the band. It is the latest example of Beckwith being an embarrassment to our state. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. As one of the world’s most important steel-producing regions, Hoosier steel should be powering the development of projects across the country, especially those on government property like the White House. Indiana Democratic Congressman Frank Mrvan recently introduced an amendment that would have required all steel used in construction of Trump’s White House ballroom to be American made. It was defeated by the Republican majority in Congress. Republicans are using your tax dollars to purchase foreign steel and undermining American workers. If our government won’t support and purchase American steel, it sets a poor precedent for the private-sector. It’s time for Republicans to stand with American workers and stop supporting the illegal dumping of foreign steel. | | Patriot,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

---
**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Patriot, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

clean_body: “No, you’re not thinking what I’m thinking...” | | | | | Patriot, I'm going to be blunt with you. We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit. Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Patriot, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. The question is whether it's enough. Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America... They're not the majority. They 're the exception. They're the ones willing to take the heat. The ones willing to stand alone. The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: " I love this country." And every time one of those students raises their hand... We have a choice. Back them. Or leave them on their own. Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. Everything they need to actually stand their ground. Not symbolically. For real. They've already made the decision to lead. All they're waiting on... is you and me. Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. $25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school. $25 to put real tools in their hands. $25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time. But here's what gives me hope, Patriot... Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating. Because every day, more students are stepping forward. Not because it's easy or popular... But because they know what 's at stake. They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to. They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged. They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... But from the ground up. One student. One school. One chapter at a time. And Patriot -- that's exactly how we take this country back. But only if we move fast enough. Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break. They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in. And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction... Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes. And once it closes... It closes for good. That's what's at stake. Let's not waste this moment. Let's back our brave students -- while it still matters. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. I need you to hear this clearly... Charlie Kirk wasn't just dreaming big when he called me last year about Club America's progress. He was warning us: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. Look around. Club America may be in 13% of high schools... But in the other 87%? There is no pushback against the Left. No one telling those kids the truth. Just a Leftist pipeline -- from classroom... to belief... to voting booth. And once that pipeline is complete... It 's over. Patriot, this is one of the last places a patriot like you can stop it before it 's too late to save our country. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can give critical support to a young freedom fighter who will. There's still time to turn this country around... and this is one of the few ways we can actually do it -- one student, one school, one chapter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

Peter, this governor's race is a simple choice.
**Option A:** We either have a Republican governor bringing Trump’s MAGA agenda to California, a candidate in the pocket of corporations, or a self-funding billionaire who’s out of touch with what it takes to make ends meet in this state.
**Option B: Katie Porter.**
Katie’s not in this to pander to special interests or protect the status quo. She’s running to take on the people and systems making California unaffordable for working families.
She’s a single mom who’s lived the stress of stretching a paycheck, balancing child care, and making tough calls. She brings her lived experience into every fight she takes on.
Katie’s focused on the real issues Californians are facing—lowering housing costs, cracking down on corporate price gouging, and making child care more affordable so families can _actually_ stay in this state and build a life here.
**The difference is clear. One side has corporate money and self-funding, and our side has people-power.** Katie refuses corporate PAC money—because you can’t take on the system if you’re funded by it.
So here’s the moment, Peter. The June primary decides which candidates move on to the November ballot—which means _everything_ we do right now matters.
**We need your help to make sure Katie makes the top two, has the resources to compete, and gets her message in front of voters across California.**

Peter, MAGA Mayes Middleton is confused. I’m not.

**Middleton thinks that the Texas AG should “use every resource and tool to advance [President Trump’s] conservative agenda.”**

It was the first bill I introduced when I came to Congress and getting it done took persistence, partnership across the aisle and a lot of people in this district who refused to give up. This is the kind of work I came to Congress to do. Fighting for the people in this district and getting results. But to keep doing it I need to win this race. Republicans have recruited a candidate to run against me and the NRCC is already spending millions to flip this seat. This district is one of the ones that decides the House majority and they are not going to let up. = | | | = | = | = | = | = Thank you for standing with me. Peter, I flew B-1 combat missions over Afghanistan and spent 20 years in uniform with the knowledge that bad leadership does not just embarrass people, it kills them. I say that because I want you to understand exactly what lens I am looking through when I tell you that what happened at the Pentagon this week left me genuinely ashamed for the institution I gave two decades of my life to. [**Help us put a combat veteran in Congress who will fight to restore its honor before this administration finishes dismantling it.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8wkVHTyAFgeK7DcdMn6ru8vo-pi6SMKPgbvDFP91pH4M_IXr2jFz7QciQRF6iteqDojx4SNlGkq7OJ3zeeOh0yHVA4YxXVALhnc4p9SFfmfK0HkNQCNo6L6i70pg5gbW-SEM0uuvBpW4cZYFB_5C5ZWEbtGq6kqj8MSbSyYld64KJ9ZvfIzUbhlvrMK0O-BwnbuNCpQdpQH9GnyW7MSwvfOIPSpHUvXvWakfTc4Bwl_lmayDsG-c0X4jSCAGIvgcKDH2__MwyYxZ4HMKtQ4khkP9E8AqFk7GfbLYXpAHqgm7/4q2/I_kwlCHiQs-U0ktqdnp09Q/h1/h001.eOh_WE8sipQakw3Q4H2cx4X0eNXEN9-ftcsRNCUdP3Y) This week Pete Hegseth fired the Secretary of the Navy in the middle of the United States enforcing a naval blockade of Iran. The man spent the day on Capitol Hill discussing shipbuilding with senators and found out he no longer had a job when he saw the announcement posted on X. We’re running out of time!
Finals are here and the college semester is ending, which means that we have a little more than a week left to get out on campus and register students before they leave for summer break.
College campuses are one of the best places to meet young Texans where they are and help them get registered to vote.
Powered by People has been on the ground on campuses across Texas because we know the path to winning isn’t a last-minute sprint in October. We have to show up now to have in person conversations with these young Texans, to build relationships of trust, to get them registered, to stay in touch with them and to make sure they vote in the most important elections of our lives.
Once campuses clear out, this work gets a lot harder. We’ll still be on big college campuses for summer school and will spend more time at Community Colleges as well, but we won’t have the same volume. Our next big chance to register students at scale will come in August, when the fall semester starts.
[**Will you chip in $3 right now to help power this final week of campus voter registration before summer? Your support helps us keep organizers on the road, get volunteers where they need to be, and reach more students before they leave campus.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260424.HXFWe7&refcode=ema20260424-240810&t=3&akid=240810%2E444211%2Et7MVSy)

**Donald Trump is calling mail-in voting “cheating” while he just voted by mail in the Florida special election in March.** It’s a clear double standard: one set of rules for him and his allies, and another for everyone else.

**That’s not how our democracy is supposed to work.** New Dems are fighting Trump’s attack on voting rights at every turn and standing up for every American’s right to vote!

body:
Then ask yourself who's protecting it.

| | | | |
---
Hey Peter, If you've ever driven through Middle Tennessee in the spring, you know why it’s worth protecting. The rolling hills, the farmland stretching out in every direction, the rivers and creeks that wind through places people have called home for generations. It's not just pretty. It's the backbone of how people live here. Hunting, fishing, farming, and raising families on land their grandparents worked. That's not something you can take for granted. And right now, we don't think enough people in Washington understand that. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/zQ3Ck_-lGx9oOH_mfSa0iA~~/AAUS1hA~/pAr-LTU1WUmp19nwJeyCqeBdEC1zgyuyzwHEvRF53conyJulAb7Bbn9mjCZ3ilmf3tIEYm603qMtyOzSFsWmaswLR9QGYLNTrzea6vTqt8nTnosCMcArJmQz0Yb7PvRelXw1PoCoSd3e9semGVkx3bavGrssYVUltjVlQ53LqhUrpAzUbC9BRGypcHilIG-MQoFxtUGfAwixPOYgpIntrptI7TPGOGx8rb81s0uN3oToUtfn9w2DcM34lXjyhKwu) The new budget slashes funding for conservation programs and guts environmental protections that keep our water clean and our public lands accessible. Energy assistance for families struggling with utility bills? Gone. And the people voting for these cuts don't seem to lose a minute of sleep over what it means for communities like ours. Andy Ogles is one of those people. He's had every opportunity to stand up for the land and the people of this district, and instead, he's spent his time building a platform for himself. The rivers, fields, and farms of TN-5 don't trend on Twitter, so they don't seem to make his priority list. Chaz grew up on this land. He runs on it every morning. He's raised his kids on it. He's spent nearly eight years as mayor trying to keep Columbia clean, beautiful, and worth being proud of. That's not a talking point for him. It's just Tuesday. TN-5 deserves someone in Congress who fights to protect this place because they actually love it. ### About Chaz Molder

clean_body: Then ask yourself who's protecting it. | | | | | Hey Peter, If you've ever driven through Middle Tennessee in the spring, you know why it’s worth protecting. The rolling hills, the farmland stretching out in every direction, the rivers and creeks that wind through places people have called home for generations. It's not just pretty. It's the backbone of how people live here. Hunting, fishing, farming, and raising families on land their grandparents worked. That's not something you can take for granted. And right now, we don't think enough people in Washington understand that. The new budget slashes funding for conservation programs and guts environmental protections that keep our water clean and our public lands accessible. Energy assistance for families struggling with utility bills? Gone. And the people voting for these cuts don't seem to lose a minute of sleep over what it means for communities like ours. Andy Ogles is one of those people. He's had every opportunity to stand up for the land and the people of this district, and instead, he's spent his time building a platform for himself. The rivers, fields, and farms of TN-5 don't trend on Twitter, so they don't seem to make his priority list. Chaz grew up on this land. He runs on it every morning. He's raised his kids on it. He's spent nearly eight years as mayor trying to keep Columbia clean, beautiful, and worth being proud of. That's not a talking point for him. It's just Tuesday. TN-5 deserves someone in Congress who fights to protect this place because they actually love it. Not because it polls well. ~~ | | ~~ | We only get one Tennessee. Immigrant detention is already unjust and inhumane, but Trump’s administration is trying to expand it rapidly by buying up warehouses across the country. Already, ICE’s mostly for-profit detention centers are deeply dehumanizing, abusive, and deadly.
So far in 2026, at least 17 people have died in ICE detention. Relatedly, detention staff routinely violate people’s human and constitutional rights to due process, clean water, necessary medical care, and more.
Confining people in massive, makeshift warehouses will exponentially increase the risks of death and abuse.
These warehouses also take huge amounts of water and land. A Georgia city manager said that one proposed warehouse detention center’s planned water usage would “drain the town” of water, using more than the town’s total permit of a million gallons a day.
So far, local residents have succeeded in blocking that facility.
And across the country, everyday people are speaking up and blocking proposed ICE detention centers in their communities—including in my congressional district.
I’m lifting up this movement in Congress and introducing the _Ban Warehouse Detention Act_ in partnership with Detention Watch Network, a grassroots organization working to end immigration detention.

The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has spent about a billion dollars in the past few months to buy warehouses across the country. It’s begun converting them into ICE detention centers that could each cage up to 10,000 people.

The Trump administration’s focus on buying up warehouses has benefitted Trump’s donors, advisors, and business partners. This new model of immigrant detention is tied to Trump’s own grift, profits, and corruption.
Most ICE detention centers are for-profit. They get paid based on how many people they’ve locked up, so they have quotas of the numbers of beds they want to fill in order to make more money.
They already fail to provide necessary medical care, clean drinking water, sanitation, calls to lawyers and families, and other basic rights owed to the immigrants they’ve caged.
These warehouse detention centers will likely be privately-run, as well.
Warehouses are meant to hold objects, not humans. And these will not be temporary holding spaces. **They’re industrial-scale operations designed to process human beings like cargo, stripping them of dignity and due process.**
That’s why I’ve introduced the _Ban Warehouse Detention Act_ with Detention Watch Network, a grassroots organization working to end immigration detention—the unjust and inhumane practice of jailing immigrants while they await a determination of their immigration status or potential deportation.
**This Saturday, Detention Watch Network is coordinating a National Day of Action to Stop ICE Warehouse Detention** , with hundreds of actions planned across the country.1

Thank you for taking action.
We will continue building the movement demanding our government abolish ICE, end the criminalization of migration, protect immigrants’ rights, and finally enact a humane immigration system in this country.
I just hosted another Know Your Rights Training with ACLU Michigan and Michigan Immigrant Rights Center (MIRC) to protect people from ICE. More trainings will come, and we will keep showing up for each other.
With you in the fight for our rights and our shared humanity,
