clean_body: Today, I introduced the Ban Warehouse Detention Act. | | | Friend, I just introduced the Ban Warehouse Detention Act to stop the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) from converting or using warehouses for ICE detention centers. Immigrant detention is already unjust and inhumane, but Trump’s administration is trying to expand it rapidly by buying up warehouses across the country. Each warehouse could cage between 1,500 and 10,000 people! Warehouses are designed and built to hold objects, not people. People are not commodities to be shipped, discarded, and profited off of. | Already, ICE’s mostly for-profit detention centers are deeply dehumanizing, abusive, and deadly. So far in 2026, at least 17 people have died in ICE detention. Relatedly, detention staff routinely violate people’s human and constitutional rights to due process, clean water, necessary medical care, and more. Confining people in massive, makeshift warehouses will exponentially increase the risks of death and abuse. These warehouses also take huge amounts of water and land. A Georgia city manager said that one proposed warehouse detention center’s planned water usage would “drain the town” of water, using more than the town’s total permit of a million gallons a day. So far, local residents have succeeded in blocking that facility. And across the country, everyday people are speaking up and blocking proposed ICE detention centers in their communities—including in my congressional district. I’m lifting up this movement in Congress and introducing the Ban Warehouse Detention Act in partnership with Detention Watch Network, a grassroots organization working to end immigration detention. Thank you for taking action. We’ll keep fighting for our rights, including the due process rights of every U.S. resident, regardless of immigration status. Together, we’re growing the movement to abolish ICE. If you can, please for the National Day of Action to Stop ICE Warehouse Detention.(If you don’t see an action near you, you can find everything you need to host one .) In solidarity, Rashida \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Thu, Apr 23, 2026 Subject: Act now to block ICE warehouse detention centers To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has spent about a billion dollars in the past few months to buy warehouses across the country. It’s begun converting them into ICE detention centers that could each cage up to 10,000 people. We cannot allow this rapid expansion of immigrant detention. Already, at least 17 people have died or been killed in ICE detention facilities so far in 2026. That’s one death per week on average, putting our country on a path to far exceed last year’s horrific record high. Communities in my district and across the country are pushing back against these warehouses, fighting for our neighbors and our shared humanity. Some have successfully blocked these detention centers. Today, I introduced a new piece of legislation: the** Ban Warehouse Detention Act , which would prohibit DHS from converting or operating any warehouse for the purpose of detaining people. The Trump administration’s focus on buying up warehouses has benefitted Trump’s donors, advisors, and business partners. This new model of immigrant detention is tied to Trump’s own grift, profits, and corruption. Most ICE detention centers are for-profit. They get paid based on how many people they’ve locked up, so they have quotas of the numbers of beds they want to fill in order to make more money. They already fail to provide necessary medical care, clean drinking water, sanitation, calls to lawyers and families, and other basic rights owed to the immigrants they’ve caged. These warehouse detention centers will likely be privately-run, as well. Warehouses are meant to hold objects, not humans. And these will not be temporary holding spaces. They’re industrial-scale operations designed to process human beings like cargo, stripping them of dignity and due process. That’s why I’ve introduced the Ban Warehouse Detention Act with Detention Watch Network, a grassroots organization working to end immigration detention—the unjust and inhumane practice of jailing immigrants while they await a determination of their immigration status or potential deportation. This Saturday, Detention Watch Network is coordinating a National Day of Action to Stop ICE Warehouse Detention , with hundreds of actions planned across the country.1 Thank you for taking action. We will continue building the movement demanding our government abolish ICE, end the criminalization of migration, protect immigrants’ rights, and finally enact a humane immigration system in this country. I just hosted another Know Your Rights Training with ACLU Michigan and Michigan Immigrant Rights Center (MIRC) to protect people from ICE. More trainings will come, and we will keep showing up for each other. With you in the fight for our rights and our shared humanity, Rashida 1 this Saturday’s Stop ICE Warehouse Detention Day of Action. If you don’t find an action close enough to you, you may consider . More than 13,000 families signed up in the first four months alone. This is what conservative leadership looks like. But here's the truth: None of it is permanent. The Left is watching Florida. Liberal special interests and radical education activists want nothing more than to reverse every one of these gains, to put bureaucrats back in charge, push parents back out, and undo the model that is making Florida the envy of the nation. body:
#
My name is Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
When I first ran for office, some people who fashion themselves "political strategists" or "experts" said, "You shouldn't do your full last name. Having two last names is weird."
They even said, "What are people gonna call you?" 😂
**I said no. If I can't run as myself, then I don't want to run at all.** If I can't be myself and stick to my values, then what is the point of any of it?
**And you know what, I won my race.** People figured out how to say my name, and _they gave me a name._
__
I say this because I want you to have the courage to listen to your gut — even when the experts are telling you that what is “smart” is not in alignment with what you think is right in your integrity.
With gratitude,
Alexandria

# [Trump sold us out](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=195179755&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk1MTc5NzU1LCJpYXQiOjE3NzcwNjY0MjUsImV4cCI6MTc3OTY1ODQyNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.rG-0G5PzWESVJPyZWbiYoO7KzvTQ_n7MTX7JXQe1yHI)
### He promised peace and instead gave us a billion-dollar war.
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Apr 24
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..Xlyv6FfnYAIN2wIVz5MQVvkDoA3C-cSq2Fr4UW1IwEQ?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/trump-sold-us-out?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends,
Donald Trump made a lot of promises when he was on the campaign trail. One of them was that he would be a "peace president" and that he would lower the cost of living for working families.
Look how that turned out.
**Instead of promoting peace OR lowering costs, Trump sold out Michigan voters to a billion-dollar-a-day war that is only increasing our costs.**
I keep asking myself: _Who is this war really for?_
A senseless, directionless war with Iran doesn't make any of us safer. It doesn't provide health care for the millions of Americans struggling to pay high insurance premiums or going without insurance altogether. It doesn't lower prices at the pump or in our grocery stores - prices are skyrocketing all over the country.
But you know what this war IS doing? It's putting money in the pockets of defense contractors and the corporations that paved the way for Trump's presidency in the first place. It's making the ultra-rich even wealthier while working Americans pay the price.
That's not what Americans want.
What Americans want - what our country needs - is leadership that is on the ground listening to the folks who make up the backbone of our economy.
The teachers, nurses, union members, and people who actually live with the day-to-day consequences of high-level policy decisions.
**[That's why I'm in this race, folks.](https://substack.com/redirect/1f372ade-cdbf-4432-a1da-ce082e6cb824?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Because the results of this battleground race are not theoretical. There are real Michiganders whose lives will be affected by who becomes our state's next senator.
For guys like Trump and Mike Rogers, this race is just another way to line their pockets while accumulating more power and fame.
They don't care about our families, our communities, or our state. All they care about is how they can use us to further their own bottom lines.
**That 's not what it's about for me.**
For me, this race is about whether the people of Michigan have a senator who wakes up every day thinking about workers, families, farms, factories, and small businesses - and whether regular folks can actually afford to live.
It is about whether the people who built this state - people like my own family - have somebody in the Senate who will fight for them or whether this seat gets handed over to Mike Rogers and the MAGA billionaires trying to buy it.
**[At the end of the day, I'm in this race for my state, my neighbors, my family - and for you.](https://substack.com/redirect/1f372ade-cdbf-4432-a1da-ce082e6cb824?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
That's who I'm standing with.
That's who I'm fighting for.
With grit,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

name: Dan Goldman
subject: This merger is dangerous for our democracy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dan Goldman for New York**
body:
This latest media merger is very bad news. |
---
Peter, this is very bad news. Shareholders of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. just voted overwhelmingly to approve a takeover by Paramount Skydance Corp. This vote is shameful — but it's only the first step in the process, and there's still time to stop it. It still must go through regulatory antitrust review. Any good-faith application of the law would nullify this merger. **But we all know that this merger will be decided by one man — Donald Trump — who wants to turn media into state television and enrich his billionaire buddies like Larry Ellison.** _This deal attacks the First Amendment_ and enriches Trump’s billionaire cronies, all while harming jobs in the film industry and suppressing the diversity of voices in news and entertainment. **I was proud to stand with artists and workers yesterday to protest this merger and I will continue to use Congressional oversight authority to fight back against monopolies like this one.** **[Peter, the fight is not over and I need you to join me. Chip in whatever you can to help defeat this dangerous and corrupt merger. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130113360/616664324/1432826945?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260424_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDhmMjljNS0yNDQwLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tHqjxpbJ5zuMy55TDFoM9Wi8M-fhE3JGCS6IxLXWSvE=)** | [CHIP IN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130113361/616664326/-1870630518?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260424_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDhmMjljNS0yNDQwLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tHqjxpbJ5zuMy55TDFoM9Wi8M-fhE3JGCS6IxLXWSvE=)

This merger is a major step in the Ellison family’s bid to consolidate control over American media. Led by Warner Bros. owner Larry Ellison — the world’s sixth-richest person — and his son David Ellison of Skydance, this deal would put CNN, CBS, HBO, Warner Bros., DC Comics, and networks like MTV and Nickelodeon under the influence of a single family.
That level of control doesn’t just reshape Hollywood — it threatens to silence dissent, narrow the range of voices we hear, and put thousands of jobs at risk. We’ve seen what happens when extreme wealth is used to bend institutions to private interests. A functioning democracy depends on an independent press and a diverse, competitive creative economy. This merger puts both in jeopardy.
While Trump will undoubtedly direct his DOJ to roll over for the Ellisons, it's not a done deal yet. Several state attorneys general are already weighing legal challenges, and European Union regulators will scrutinize it closely.
**I will continue to use every tool available through congressional oversight to fight back against monopolies like this one and the further consolidation of our media by a handful of billionaires. I am counting on your support to re-elect me to Congress to stay in this fight.**

clean_body: This latest media merger is very bad news. | Peter, this is very bad news. Shareholders of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. just voted overwhelmingly to approve a takeover by Paramount Skydance Corp. This vote is shameful — but it's only the first step in the process, and there's still time to stop it. It still must go through regulatory antitrust review. Any good-faith application of the law would nullify this merger. But we all know that this merger will be decided by one man — Donald Trump — who wants to turn media into state television and enrich his billionaire buddies like Larry Ellison. This deal attacks the First Amendment and enriches Trump’s billionaire cronies, all while harming jobs in the film industry and suppressing the diversity of voices in news and entertainment. I was proud to stand with artists and workers yesterday to protest this merger and I will continue to use Congressional oversight authority to fight back against monopolies like this one. = | = This merger is a major step in the Ellison family’s bid to consolidate control over American media. Led by Warner Bros. owner Larry Ellison — the world’s sixth-richest person — and his son David Ellison of Skydance, this deal would put CNN, CBS, HBO, Warner Bros., DC Comics, and networks like MTV and Nickelodeon under the influence of a single family. That level of control doesn’t just reshape Hollywood — it threatens to silence dissent, narrow the range of voices we hear, and put thousands of jobs at risk. We’ve seen what happens when extreme wealth is used to bend institutions to private interests. A functioning democracy depends on an independent press and a diverse, competitive creative economy. This merger puts both in jeopardy. While Trump will undoubtedly direct his DOJ to roll over for the Ellisons, it's not a done deal yet. Several state attorneys general are already weighing legal challenges, and European Union regulators will scrutinize it closely. I will continue to use every tool available through congressional oversight to fight back against monopolies like this one and the further consolidation of our media by a handful of billionaires. Things are getting serious in Texas, Fellow Patriot.

My friend, Chip Roy, is in a runoff for Texas Attorney General. Everything is on the line.

I've known Chip a long time - and I don't say this lightly: There is no one tougher, more relentless, and no one more committed to the America First agenda than Chip Roy.

He's stood shoulder to shoulder with President Trump, fighting to undo the damage of the Biden years and restore law and order, secure our border, and defend the Constitution.

In Congress, Chip has taken on the cartels flooding our communities with drugs and crime. He's fought to protect the integrity of our elections. And he's been a leading voice demanding real border security - not empty promises.

**Now, in this runoff, the stakes couldn't be higher.**

The establishment is coming for Chip Roy. California billionaires and special interest groups are pouring into Texas to try to buy this election.

_They know Chip won't bend.
They know he can't be bought.
And that's exactly why they're trying to stop him._

Texas is the backbone of conservative leadership in this country. We cannot allow coastal elites to come in, meddle in our elections, and install someone who won't fight.

Texas doesn't need just any Republican.

body:
| We need another housing boom in America.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9752%2E5257348%2EA7Teve)
Derek, In California and across America, far too many people struggle to make rent or find a home they can afford. The problem isn’t simply unemployment — which remains relatively low — but the fact that people working two or three jobs still can’t find affordable places to live. There aren’t enough homes, and housing prices are skyrocketing. Right now, our nation needs a housing boom, just as we did after WWII, when we built millions of affordable homes for returning GIs. We need millions of new homes at a price point that is actually _accessible_ to working and middle-class families. **That’s why I introduced the Housing BOOM Act.** [](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2604_HousingBoom?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260424_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=9752%2E5257348%2EA7Teve) My bill would dramatically increase the supply of affordable new homes for middle-income and lower-income families by tripling the amount of support the federal government gives through tax credits. Because we need to build a lot of housing — fast. [](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2604_HousingBoom?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260424_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=9752%2E5257348%2EA7Teve) It would make it possible for young people to own a home or pay their rent without struggling to make ends meet. [](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2604_HousingBoom?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260424_PM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=9752%2E5257348%2EA7Teve) And it would ensure that the workers who build that housing can live in the communities where they work. A promise we simply aren’t meeting right now. None of this should be controversial. But getting a bill this massive in scope that will change the way housing is built in this country won’t be easy. **[Will you sign on as a citizen-cosponsor of my Housing BOOM Act? I’m working every single day to make California and our entire country an affordable place for working people to call home.](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2604_HousingBoom?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260424_PM1_V1_S1&t=7&akid=9752%2E5257348%2EA7Teve)**_ | [ SIGN ON ](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2604_HousingBoom?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260424_PM1_V1_S1&t=8&akid=9752%2E5257348%2EA7Teve)

Adam

name: Gary Sinise, American Veterans Center
subject: Why this Memorial Day matters more than ever
body:
I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more.

| | |
---
Friend,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc-O2yAQxp8G3xLhgYBz4FAp8m17qCr1iCbDJEYLtgs4q7x95W1662Wv8_0Z_fT9evNvGFOc798xsyvt5kv1H9OzTbFmzkuJmAI-M7bGpXqQYA5SH0DvPuiCCxSwp45db62VxvaD7SanToNRxoSBzpIGe7OMV61OHMBegcl00e1VUoOGXhswx5NGkHg1yMzUQy-0xMSlHQuv2zVFwrlhfb8thfhIS-6Sm1pbq1DfBIwCxsq0FT7izGFpu0PAiJnLnjw8uHHBuR6I58Zllx70SePvWJ7-H6pQY122QuxpCSzU5cfP8XweLAgwW8s-c4hbFurCGWN6Hf8mhLpMWALWd4_0-yUR5hXjfRbq8v-HXXFh_YgpxWqs0PK-937yta-v8XDwJwAA____350Z)

subject: The wannabe dictator is demanding more fealty
disclaimer_text: Paid for by United for Democracy
body:
Trump thinks the guys who gave him presidential immunity have gone “weak, stupid, and bad.” | |
---
Confirmation Peter, If you feel like the Supreme Court lets Trump get away with every illegal, unconstitutional activity he comes up with, you’re not alone. **Studies show that the MAGA Roberts Court sides with Trump 90% of the time.** **But apparently 90% isn’t enough for the wannabe dictator.** In a Truth Social post this week, he blasted the conservative justices for becoming “weak, stupid, and bad.” His discontent comes in the wake of a rare unfavorable ruling for him, in which two of the justices he appointed knocked down his tariff regime. He also appears suspicious that they’ll rule against him on birthright citizenship. **But this is still the same exact Court that handed him presidential immunity and gave him the powers of a king in America. And with two potential retirements on the horizon, Trump is focused on his opportunity to install younger, more radical justices who display even more loyalty and fealty to him.** **We can’t let Trump get away with throwing a tantrum the one time the MAGA Supreme Court deigns to defend the Constitution.** If Trump gets to appoint and confirm two new Supreme Court justices, he’ll rip apart our Constitution for good and cement his MAGA agenda for decades to come. [**We could be facing the biggest confirmation fight in our lives soon. If we don’t give this battle everything we’ve got, court reform will become even harder to achieve. clean_body: Trump thinks the guys who gave him presidential immunity have gone “weak, stupid, and bad.” | | Confirmation Peter, If you feel like the Supreme Court lets Trump get away with every illegal, unconstitutional activity he comes up with, you’re not alone. Studies show that the MAGA Roberts Court sides with Trump 90% of the time. But apparently 90% isn’t enough for the wannabe dictator. In a Truth Social post this week, he blasted the conservative justices for becoming “weak, stupid, and bad.” His discontent comes in the wake of a rare unfavorable ruling for him, in which two of the justices he appointed knocked down his tariff regime. He also appears suspicious that they’ll rule against him on birthright citizenship. But this is still the same exact Court that handed him presidential immunity and gave him the powers of a king in America. And with two potential retirements on the horizon, Trump is focused on his opportunity to install younger, more radical justices who display even more loyalty and fealty to him. We can’t let Trump get away with throwing a tantrum the one time the MAGA Supreme Court deigns to defend the Constitution. If Trump gets to appoint and confirm two new Supreme Court justices, he’ll rip apart our Constitution for good and cement his MAGA agenda for decades to come. There’s only a limited amount of time for Trump to get to install the justices he wants on the Court. We know it, the Supreme Court justices know it, and based on his Truth Social tantrum, he knows it too. Trump and his MAGA cronies could be in for a big loss in the 2026 midterm elections—that’s why they’ve been fighting so hard to rig them. If they lose the Senate, a stalemate on Trump’s potential nominees is all but guaranteed. With Trump’s discontent growing, pressure is mounting on Alito and Thomas to step down with enough time for the wannabe dictator to force through a new, totally loyal justice. That means our work is more important than ever before. We’re coordinating the progressive response to every move Trump makes to further pack the Court, warp the justice system, and rip up the Constitution once and for all. We’re working with allies across issue areas, experts, and activists across the country. That's why we MUST elect Democrats who aren't afraid to stand up to Trump and take back the House in the Midterm Elections. I faced down Donald Trump's violent mob on January 6th. And that's exactly what I'll do in Congress.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

U.S. Sen. Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) appeared at a Senate Judiciary subcommittee hearing Tuesday to examine the Biden administration FBI’s Arctic Frost investigation, calling the probe an “indiscriminate dragnet” that targeted hundreds of Republican groups and individuals.

The Arctic Frost investigation, later taken over by former Special Counsel Jack Smith, involved secret subpoenas for the personal phone records of 14 members of Congress, including 11 senators. Britt and her colleagues have requested that telecommunications companies involved release all records relating to the probe.

WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump’s pick to lead the Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh, received praise from most Republicans on the Senate panel overseeing his confirmation Tuesday, including U.S. Sen. Katie Britt, R-Ala., but one GOP senator is putting up a major roadblock to the nominee.

During Warsh’s confirmation hearing in the Senate Banking Committee, U.S. Sen. Thom Tillis, R-N.C., doubled down on his threat to block Warsh’s nomination until the Department of Justice ends the criminal probe into current Fed Chair Jerome Powell. Britt looked ready to find a way to move past the hold on Warsh’s nomination. But she emphasized that Congress needs answers to questions on how the money is being spent on the renovations.

Fighting back against Donald Trump doesn’t start with speeches. It starts with action: opposing his agenda, voting to impeach him, and holding every single person in his administration accountable.

I’m Dr. Annie Andrews, a pediatrician, a mom of three, and the Democrat running for U.S. Senate to defeat Republican Lindsey Graham in South Carolina.
If we flip this seat, we can end Lindsey Graham’s career and help Democrats retake the Senate, and expand the map for Democrats in future elections.
I know this won’t be easy. But I’ve treated kids who were shot, hospitalized, and failed by broken systems. Nothing about this moment feels optional.
We need an overwhelming surge of grassroots support to prove that we can finally defeat Lindsey Graham. So I’m humbly asking: Will you chip in a split donation of $50, $30, or even $15 between Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign right now so we can hit our end of quarter goals? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
Let me introduce myself.
I’ve spent nearly 20 years serving my community as a pediatrician, treating everything from asthma and violent trauma to the emotional toll of growing up in poverty.
I’ve seen what bad policy does to good families — and I’ve seen kids suffer because people like Lindsey Graham would rather protect their own power than protect children.
In 2022, after 15 years of working in hospitals, I ran for Congress because I knew our kids needed a voice in Washington. I lost — and I told my oldest daughter I wouldn’t run again.
But then Trump’s chaos came back.
And Lindsey Graham? He cheered.
The truth is, I’m scared. And I’m angry. And I’m done waiting.
So I’m stepping up — because our kids, and this country can’t afford another six years of Lindsey Graham.
I’m building a people-powered campaign to flip South Carolina and give kids the voice they deserve. And I need your help. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]

Peter,

There’s something you learn pretty quickly as a farmer.

You learn that you can’t ignore what’s in front of you. You have to pay attention, listen, and care.

That’s how I’ve lived my life, and how I believe in running this campaign.

Somewhere along the way, Washington politicians forgot who they’re working for. They became obsessed with proving a point, fighting just to prove each other wrong. They make decisions that benefit themselves or their donors, leaving families in communities like the North Country feeling ignored.

**I want you to know this: I will never forget who I am fighting for.**

I am running to restore what has been lost, to show how to make people feel heard again. We can do better. I believe that leadership should be grounded in real life. And I believe that the people of the North Country deserve someone who will actually listen.

You learn that you can’t ignore what’s in front of you. You have to pay attention, listen, and care. That’s how I’ve lived my life, and how I believe in running this campaign. Somewhere along the way, Washington politicians forgot who they’re working for. They became obsessed with proving a point, fighting just to prove each other wrong. They make decisions that benefit themselves or their donors, leaving families in communities like the North Country feeling ignored. Republican Task Force Issue: 4/24/2026
Iran Talks Move to Islamabad

President Trump is sending special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to Islamabad on Saturday for [direct negotiations with Iran's foreign minister](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLFuhDAQRL8GOiOz-Gxd4SIN3aVNidb2cqzwYWSboPx9xDXp063eSqOZ9_WYHsiRt-cnvsjmOk8hhelcuNKSjkKFagEJmiL5ymm6biGVADVtcYI22OAD9r4l2xtjpFFy6NvFKgM43CR5p525DQBSOjdoBzqQvvfUsr2ipAIFg5KD7Ix3-o5GEhrobwCNkhgp1y7TfrjIHreKZZ1T9tT59GqjXWrdSzN8NDA2MJ7n2WU6KuVy_S-ScgwNjFgYxY6eZ_YX5rqmeRbrUZaNslgIAwWx48ql4iY44yYqxrWItwjxNiEK_hTxt7-Bsc027CfHyEWbRsnnCzm-u9V_qPy28BsAAP__FyKCQw) -- the first real diplomatic engagement since the US-Israel strike on February 28. Vice President Vance is on standby to join if talks show progress; members of his staff will be in Islamabad. Witkoff and Kushner have worked back-channel contacts for months on Iran's nuclear material. The Pakistan talks mark the first time those conversations have a formal venue and a foreign minister at the table. [A separate ceasefire extension](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDFuxCAURE-DOyz8waAUFGncbdqU1jd8r1EwWMAu14-cI6QZPWmkN9J8P9YHhhjS8wtPsqXtq89-7UdodORXpUqtggBNkVwLeb2ZC8VBrSmuMHjrncfJDWQnY4wwSshpOCy6eQYp9C5hgxm1JJiFn6RxWuMOfgj2VgkFCqQSUozGbfoDjSA0MM0ATAmMVNpY6HptMThMDevPnouj0eVziPZo7apMfjJYGCy999GldHcMltvOYBHq5jt6LtEzWGJ4E0_UK4MlFEy8Y-GtvM6Lh1qQIo-0YcppKNZfPcQYqjZMieeJIf4tt38c9bbwGwAA___pYnSC) for the Israel-Lebanon front was announced Thursday, clearing the diplomatic lane. With gas topping $4/gallon nationally and 20% of global crude transiting the Strait of Hormuz, the economic pressure to find an off-ramp is mounting. The Islamabad talks are [the most concrete step yet](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLFuhDAQRL_GdKBlMTgULtLQXdqUaDHLscKHke2Lfz8in5Bm9IrRPGm-H_ODxMv5_KIX25i3eQ3rXHbJvId34sQ5IeDAnl2WMN9cg65Rz6efsVrt6lZqXcW2NcaA0dC11W4X2Ij0AqzZtNT3_dhvemDNsC3rQKYSe0-BRo2dhg4a45ZhJANMBtseUWkgzzE3ka_34sXRmSkdW4iOGxdelbd7zldS3afCSeFUSmmu4CWLC3dB4XRySQqn26RwAn3zHcc77SfHukg-wrbVEumsLzokZTprgI8RxharaNeriPeSBqM0PF8k_k-d__HUj8XfAAAA__82g3Tj) toward ending an eight-week shooting war that has reshaped the entire political landscape. ★★★
DOJ Clears Path for Warsh

The Justice Department on Friday [dropped its criminal probe](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL1urDAUhJ_GdCBzMHgpXNyGbm-bEvnnsHZywMj2xq8fOY-QZvRJI30jzcdzf-pA4Xr91yeqVI7dRbdXHwr6-M6YsWTgsCChLSHujXsuehD7RTt0Tjnr9Gg7VKOUkkvBp7HzapXrAdLNqzHolges02M-RhAHCjQwmy6opuICBEyCT3yQ1iyrlhy1hHEGYIJrwlSGhPfbULD6Kjp_HTFZHGw8O1K-lDuz6R-DjcFWax3sZWwrGWxNz2DjonGLA11_x4pEvYuffdUp-76k93kPvpzUJeXuGohCXiQT_HXqQL9D5Q-_fCv4CQAA__-6um7v) of Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell and the Fed's building renovations -- the last major obstacle between Kevin Warsh and a Senate confirmation vote. U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro announced via X that the Fed's own inspector general would handle any remaining review. Warsh testified before the Senate Banking Committee on April 21, pledging Federal Reserve (Fed) independence and vowing he would not be the president's "sock puppet." He outlined plans to end forward guidance and begin shrinking the Fed's $6+ trillion balance sheet. NEW: Donald Trump’s EPA has failed to implement air quality standards to protect our communities from the deadly impacts of soot pollution. It’s breaking the law — so I’m suing.
The science is clear: When air quality worsens, hospital visits rise. Our children struggle to breathe. Lives are cut short. And the devastating effects fall hardest on lower-income communities and communities of color.
The EPA knows this, but it’s doing nothing.
Once again, the Trump administration is refusing to take action while communities across the country are left to deal with the deadly and costly consequences — and once again, I’m taking them to court.
If that’s all you need to hear, click here to support our work holding Trump accountable before the end of the month. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
Here’s how we got here:
In 2024, the EPA strengthened its own national soot standard based on overwhelming scientific evidence that implementing these new standards would result in significant health benefits for Americans. Like preventing 4,500 premature deaths, 5,700 new cases of asthma, and 2,000 emergency room visits in the first year alone.
But this February, the Trump EPA missed its legally mandated deadline to begin implementing that standard, willfully abandoning its duties under the Clean Air Act.
This fight is especially important for our California communities as four of the areas with the worst soot pollution in the entire country are located here.
I will not stand by while this administration breaks the law and our families are forced to breathe air that puts their health and lives at risk — so today, I’m taking action to force their hand.
